papers.title: Time crystals in cavity-BEC systems
papers.abstract: The understanding of light-induced dynamical states continues to be a challenging and fruitful pursuit of science. This pursuit is supported by quantum simulation of dynamical phenomena, e.g., in ultracold atom systems. Typically, ultracold atom dynamics are read out destructively, via time-of-flight imaging, limiting a detailed analysis. However, atom-cavity systems provide a real-time readout of the photonic state via photon emission from the cavity, making the system ideally suited for the simulation of dynamical phenomena. Here, we review three distinct time crystalline states, predicted and realized in a cavity-BEC system. We give an example for each of them, based on minimal few-mode models. We characterize the time crystalline states via correlation functions of the cavity mode, and characteristic momentum modes of the condensate. This supports a clear distinction between these time crystals. More generally, the sequence of studies reviewed here, serves as a blueprint for setting up minimal models and their characterization, for dynamical phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有综述性质）。判断依据：关键词“review”、“minimal few-mode models”、“characterize via correlation functions”。；研究对象：腔-玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（cavity-BEC）系统中的时间晶体（time crystals）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在腔-BEC系统中存在三种不同的时间晶态，可通过腔模的关联函数和凝聚体的特征动量模式进行清晰区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在腔-BEC系统中存在三种不同的时间晶态，可通过腔模的关联函数和凝聚体的特征动量模式进行清晰区分。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于最小少模模型（minimal few-mode models）进行理论建模，利用腔模的关联函数（correlation functions）和凝聚体的特征动量模式（characteristic momentum modes）对时间晶态进行表征。

papers.title: Photoluminescent Tetragonal Tb-doped Pb2P2O7
papers.abstract: In this study, we report the synthesis and characterization of a novel tetragonal polymorph of Tb-doped Pb2P2O7. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms the stabilization of the P41 and P43 enantiomorphs at room temperature due to the incorporation of Tb3+ ions. Optical investigations reveal green photoluminescence from the characteristic 5D4 -> 7Fj (J = 1-5) transitions of Tb3+, with each emission split due to the crystal field effect, indicating the presence of Tb3+ in multiple coordination environments. The power dependence of the PL intensity follows a linear power-law behavior, suggesting a one-photon excitation process. Temperature-dependent PL measurements show an initial increase in intensity up to 125C, attributed to energy transfer from structural defects, followed by thermal quenching above this temperature. Structural stability at elevated temperatures is confirmed via high-temperature X-ray diffraction (XRD), showing no phase transitions before melting at approximately 800C. These findings highlight the potential of tetragonal Tb-doped Pb2P2O7 as a new class of photoluminescent material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：synthesis, characterization, Single-crystal X-ray diffraction, photoluminescence, temperature-dependent PL measurements, high-temperature XRD。；研究对象：新型四方相Tb掺杂焦磷酸铅（Tb-doped Pb2P2O7）多晶型材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Tb³⁺掺杂成功稳定了室温下P41和P43对映体结构的四方相Pb2P2O7，该材料在绿光波段表现出源于Tb³⁺特征跃迁的光致发光，且发光强度在125°C以下随温度升高而增强，之后发生热猝灭。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Tb³⁺掺杂成功稳定了室温下P41和P43对映体结构的四方相Pb2P2O7，该材料在绿光波段表现出源于Tb³⁺特征跃迁的光致发光，且发光强度在125°C以下随温度升高而增强，之后发生热猝灭。；创新点：首次报道了Tb掺杂Pb2P2O7的四方相多晶型，并揭示了其独特的温度依赖发光行为（低温段强度上升归因于结构缺陷的能量转移）。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线衍射（确定晶体结构）、光致发光（PL）光谱（含功率依赖和温度依赖测量）、高温X射线衍射（HT-XRD，验证高温结构稳定性）。

papers.title: Phase-dependent electronic structure of two-dimensional Ag layers at the graphene/SiC interface
papers.abstract: Intercalation at the graphene/SiC interface provides a controlled route to stabilize atomically thin layers with properties distinct from their bulk counterparts. In this platform, the structure and stability of the intercalated phase depend sensitively on the defect landscape of the starting substrate. For intercalated two-dimensional silver at the graphene/SiC interface, two phases have been observed: a phase epitaxial to the SiC lattice, Ag$_{(1)}$, readily obtained following the conventional intercalation method under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and extensively characterized, and a more densely packed phase, called Ag$_{(2)}$, which has remained largely unexplored. Here we report an in situ ultra-high-vacuum preparation method of the second phase intercalated at the graphene/SiC interface; this phase previously was prepared via high-pressure confinement heteroepitaxy. Low-energy electron diffraction shows that Ag$_{(2)}$ is rotated by 30 degree relative to the SiC lattice and forms supercells, in contrast to the $(1\times 1)$ epitaxial relation of Ag$_{(1)}$ with SiC. High-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals a more rich Ag$_{(2)}$ band dispersion compared to the Ag$_{(1)}$. In density functional theory calculations, by defining the unfolding entropy which, in a quantified way, finds that the band structure of Ag$_{(2)}$ is more suitable to be unfolded to the SiC primitive cell, and the resulting unfolded band dispersion is in great agreement with the experimental data. We further show that the different intercalated Ag phases tune the electronic properties of the overlying quasi-free-standing graphene layer differently: compared with Ag$_{(1)}$, Ag$_{(2)}$ yields an $\sim$1.75 times higher charge carrier density and modifies the charge-plasmon interaction of the graphene layer, indicating a change in effective screening at the interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：in situ ultra-high-vacuum preparation（原位超高真空制备）、low-energy electron diffraction（低能电子衍射）、high-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy（高分辨角分辨光电子能谱）、density functional theory calculations（密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：石墨烯/SiC界面处插层的二维银（Ag）层，具体为两种不同相（Ag\(_{(1)}\)和Ag\(_{(2)}\)）的电子结构及其对上层石墨烯电子性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新的、更致密的Ag\(_{(2)}\)相，其相对于SiC晶格旋转30°并形成超胞，具有比Ag\(_{(1)}\)更丰富的能带色散；Ag\(_{(2)}\)相使上层石墨烯的载流子密度提高约1.75倍，并改变了石墨烯层的电荷-等离子体激元相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新的、更致密的Ag\(_{(2)}\)相，其相对于SiC晶格旋转30°并形成超胞，具有比Ag\(_{(1)}\)更丰富的能带色散；Ag\(_{(2)}\)相使上层石墨烯的载流子密度提高约1.75倍，并改变了石墨烯层的电荷-等离子体激元相互作用。；创新点：首次通过原位超高真空方法制备了此前仅通过高压限制异质外延获得的Ag\(_{(2)}\)相，并系统揭示了其与Ag\(_{(1)}\)相在结构、能带色散以及对石墨烯电子性质调控上的显著差异。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用原位超高真空制备方法获得Ag\(_{(2)}\)相，使用低能电子衍射（LEED）表征结构，高分辨角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量能带色散；理论上采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，并定义了“unfolding entropy”（展开熵）来定量分析能带结构向SiC原胞的展开，并与实验数据对比。

papers.title: Quantum critical collapse of a pinned vortex glass
papers.abstract: The interplay between disorder and vortex--vortex interactions in strongly disordered superconductors in a magnetic field can stabilize a vortex-glass state, characterized by strong pinning and the absence of positional order. Yet its role in the destruction of superconductivity at the field-driven superconductor--insulator transition has remained unresolved. Here we use plasmonic microwave spectroscopy of superconducting resonators patterned from amorphous indium oxide thin films to directly track the superfluid density up to the critical field $B_c$. We find an unexpected resilience of the superfluid density, which decreases only logarithmically over nearly three orders of magnitude in field, in stark contrast to the rapid power-law suppression expected for vortex lattices. We attribute this anomalously slow decay to a collective vortex-pinning mechanism counterintuitively enhanced by vortex--vortex interactions. The superfluid density then vanishes linearly at $B_c$, where independent magnetoresistance measurements identify a continuous quantum critical point, unlike the abrupt transition observed at zero field. We further uncover an exceptionally large nonlinear electromagnetic response of the vortex glass, manifested as a pronounced positive-Kerr effect with potential for quantum sensing. These results show how disorder controls the critical magnetic field and identify the vortex glass as the key intermediate state governing the magnetic-field-induced superconductor--insulator transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：plasmonic microwave spectroscopy、magnetoresistance measurements、patterned from amorphous indium oxide thin films。；研究对象：强无序超导体（非晶氧化铟薄膜）中磁场驱动的超导体-绝缘体转变，以及钉扎涡旋玻璃态的量子临界坍缩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超流密度随磁场增加仅呈对数衰减（而非涡旋晶格预期的快速幂律衰减），并在临界场B_c处线性消失；该转变表现为连续量子临界点，且涡旋玻璃态展现出巨大的非线性电磁响应（正Kerr效应）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超流密度随磁场增加仅呈对数衰减（而非涡旋晶格预期的快速幂律衰减），并在临界场B_c处线性消失；该转变表现为连续量子临界点，且涡旋玻璃态展现出巨大的非线性电磁响应（正Kerr效应）。；创新点：首次直接追踪超流密度至临界场，揭示涡旋-涡旋相互作用反常增强集体钉扎机制，并发现涡旋玻璃态作为超导体-绝缘体转变关键中间态的作用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用等离激元微波光谱学测量超导谐振器的超流密度，结合独立磁电阻测量确定量子临界点。

papers.title: Orbital Selective Dirac-like States in EuAgAs Revealed by Polarization Dependent ARPES and DFT
papers.abstract: Magnetic topological semimetals provide a promising platform for emergent quantum phenomena driven by the interplay between magnetism and relativistic fermions, including anomalous transport effects and tunable topological phases. Here, we investigate the electronic structure and orbital character of EuAgAs, a magnetic topological Dirac semimetal candidate, using density functional theory (DFT) and polarization dependent angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). Fermi surface mapping and constant energy contours measured at 9 eV reveal ring like features that systematically expand with increasing binding energy, consistent with nearly linear low energy Dirac like dispersion. ARPES measurements at different photon energies hint at the presence of a van Hove singularity predicted by DFT calculations. Furthermore, this indicates that the photoemission matrix elements are highly sensitive to the excitation energy, allowing different photon energies to selectively probe distinct orbital characters. Polarization dependent ARPES measurements performed in s- and p-polarized geometries exhibit pronounced variations in spectral intensity, indicating symmetry selective orbital contributions to electronic states. These matrix element driven intensity modulations are well reproduced by DFT calculations. Furthermore, the observed Dirac like states remain nearly unchanged over the temperature range from 9 K to 30 K, suggesting that the magnetic ordering has minimal influence on the electronic structure. Our combined experimental and theoretical results provide detailed insight into the orbital selective electronic structure of EuAgAs and its implications for magnetic topological quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：同时使用了偏振依赖的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）实验和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：磁性拓扑狄拉克半金属候选材料EuAgAs的电子结构及其轨道特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在EuAgAs中观测到准线性的类狄拉克能带色散，且该电子结构在9 K至30 K温度范围内几乎不变，表明磁有序对其影响极小；同时，通过偏振依赖ARPES揭示了不同轨道对电子态的选择性贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在EuAgAs中观测到准线性的类狄拉克能带色散，且该电子结构在9 K至30 K温度范围内几乎不变，表明磁有序对其影响极小；同时，通过偏振依赖ARPES揭示了不同轨道对电子态的选择性贡献。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 偏振依赖的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES，包括s-和p-偏振几何构型）、不同光子能量下的ARPES测量、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Chirality-sensitive mobility and dissipation of Brownian motion on a helical landscape
papers.abstract: We study the Brownian dynamics and linear response of a particle with inertia moving in a 2-dimensional helical landscape imprinted on a cylindrical surface. In the harmonic well approximation, the deterministic motion separates into free propagation along the screw direction and harmonic motion in the transverse screw-normal direction. We show that for isotropic damping this simplification survives in the Langevin description, whereas anisotropic damping along the axial and angular directions couples the stochastic dynamics and destroys separability. The resulting anisotropic model is formulated as a linear Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process in phase space with a zero mode associated with diffusion along the screw coordinate, so that in an infinite system the full phase-space dynamics does not relax to a stationary distribution. To treat transport in this setting, we construct the stationary dynamics in the stable subspace obtained after projecting out the zero mode. This leads to a linear response theory for this system and yields closed analytical expressions for stationary time-correlation functions and the dynamical mobility tensor in both the time and frequency domains. The off-diagonal elements of the mobility tensor describe cross-response between axial forcing and angular motion, and between applied torque and axial transport. Consistent with time reversal symmetry, these cross mobilities are equal and provide a direct dynamical signature of the helical geometry. In addition, a simultaneous application of driving in both the axial and angular direction reveals asymmetry in energy dissipation rate due the helical landscape.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Brownian dynamics、linear response theory、Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process、analytical expressions。；研究对象：在圆柱面上螺旋势场中运动的惯性粒子的布朗动力学与线性响应行为，具体研究粒子沿轴向和角向的输运与耗散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在螺旋势场中，各向异性阻尼会耦合轴向与角向的随机动力学，导致迁移率张量出现非对角元，这些交叉迁移率在时间反演对称性下相等，直接反映了螺旋几何的动力学特征；同时，轴向与角向联合驱动会因螺旋势场而产生能量耗散率的不对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在螺旋势场中，各向异性阻尼会耦合轴向与角向的随机动力学，导致迁移率张量出现非对角元，这些交叉迁移率在时间反演对称性下相等，直接反映了螺旋几何的动力学特征；同时，轴向与角向联合驱动会因螺旋势场而产生能量耗散率的不对称性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用朗之万方程描述含惯性粒子的布朗运动，在简谐阱近似下将确定性运动分解为沿螺旋方向的自由传播和横向简谐运动；对各向异性阻尼情形，将系统建模为相空间中的线性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，通过投影掉零模构造稳定子空间中的平稳动力学，并推导出时间关联函数和动力学迁移率张量的闭合解析表达式。

papers.title: Orientable Surfactants on Thin Liquid Films: A Dynamic Density-Functional Theory Approach
papers.abstract: Thin liquid films are ubiquitous across many natural and engineering systems, including films which are laden with surface active molecules, i.e. surfactants. The presence of surfactants may have a destabilising effect on the film owing to their influence on surface tension, the so-called Marangoni effect, which in turn can induce flows in the film. Classical thin-film models for surfactant-laden films lead to paradigmatic gradient dynamics equations governing the film height and surfactant concentration and have been widely studied. However, in all these works, which are based on fluid dynamics or nonequilibrium thermodynamics, the shape of surfactants is neglected, and they have been treated as symmetric point-like particles. In general, this is a drastic oversimplification, as surfactants are amphiphilic with a polar head-tail structure. To account for this effect we use elements from the statistical mechanics of classical fluids, namely density-functional theory (DFT), and its dynamic extension (DDFT). Starting from DDFT and under the long-wave approximation, we derive the pertinent thin-film equations with the surfactants treated as polar uniaxial particles. These are equations which govern the film height, as well as the surfactant concentration and polarisation field. They preserve the gradient dynamics form by appropriately defining the free energy, which contains the usual interfacial contributions, as well as further contributions from the polarisation field. In doing so, we uncover a novel form of a generalised surface tension that is dependent on the surfactant polarisation as well as concentration, and show that it arises in a thermodynamically consistent way.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用经典流体的统计力学元素，即密度泛函理论（DFT）及其动态扩展（DDFT）”，并基于此推导方程，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：负载表面活性剂（surfactants）的薄液膜（thin liquid films），特别是考虑表面活性剂具有极性头-尾结构（polar uniaxial particles）时的薄膜动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将表面活性剂处理为极性单轴粒子，推导出控制薄膜高度、表面活性剂浓度和极化场的薄膜方程，并发现一种依赖于表面活性剂极化和浓度的广义表面张力，该张力以热力学自洽的方式出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将表面活性剂处理为极性单轴粒子，推导出控制薄膜高度、表面活性剂浓度和极化场的薄膜方程，并发现一种依赖于表面活性剂极化和浓度的广义表面张力，该张力以热力学自洽的方式出现。；创新点：首次在薄膜模型中考虑表面活性剂的形状（极性头-尾结构），而以往基于流体动力学或非平衡热力学的工作均将表面活性剂视为对称点状粒子。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 动态密度泛函理论（DDFT）结合长波近似（long-wave approximation），从统计力学出发推导薄膜方程，并保持梯度动力学形式（gradient dynamics form）。

papers.title: Multi-field Return Point Memory
papers.abstract: Non-equilibrium systems display memory, a dependence not merely on their present environment but on previously applied fields. Multistable systems such as spin glasses, martensites and granular matter have exponentially many microstates consistent with an applied field, making their rich dynamics difficult to control. Control and order can be achieved through the concept of partial ordering, which we here generalize to systems subject to multiple control fields. We demonstrate, within the model system of the zero-temperature Ising model, that this leads to return-point memory, in which an applied sequence of fields restores the hysteretic system not only to a previous magnetization, but to a previous exact microstate. The multiplicity of fields grants more precise and complex control of the system, with different classes of operations displaying commutative and noncommutative behavior. This grants new insight into how physical systems can remember, learn, and be trained.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、model system、the zero-temperature Ising model。；研究对象：多稳态非平衡系统中的记忆效应，特别是受多个控制场作用的滞后系统（如自旋玻璃、马氏体、颗粒物质）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温伊辛模型中，通过引入多个控制场实现部分有序化，可使系统在经历场序列后不仅恢复至先前的磁化强度，而且恢复至先前的精确微观态，即多场返回点记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温伊辛模型中，通过引入多个控制场实现部分有序化，可使系统在经历场序列后不仅恢复至先前的磁化强度，而且恢复至先前的精确微观态，即多场返回点记忆。；创新点：将部分有序化概念推广至受多个控制场作用的系统，揭示了多场条件下返回点记忆的新机制，并展示了多场如何赋予系统更精确、更复杂的控制能力。
papers.method_zh: 以零温伊辛模型为模型系统，通过理论分析展示多场控制下的部分有序化概念，并研究不同操作序列的交换与非交换行为。

papers.title: Interaction-Split Edge Spectral Flow and Neutral Triplet Boundary Modes in a C = 2 Hubbard Pump
papers.abstract: We show that a sliding spatial modulation of the on-site Hubbard interaction realizes a many-body Thouless pump whose boundary spectral flow is reconstructed by correlations. For a period-three Hubbard chain at filling $ρ=2/3$, density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations identify a correlated insulator with many-body Chern number $C=+2$, corresponding to two units of charge pumped per cycle. Its excitation spectrum separates the charge gap from the lowest neutral spin gap, revealing an interacting bulk response beyond a simple spin-degenerate band pump. Under open boundary conditions, this contrast becomes even more pronounced. A spin-degenerate Hartree/Aubry-André-Harper reference pump exhibits simultaneous edge flow in the two spin channels, whereas the full modulated Hubbard model suppresses the boundary doublon channel and splits the spectral flow into two distinct edge events. Between these events, the boundary charge is neutralized while a neutral, spinful triplet-like excitation is localized at the edge. The global $μ-U$ phase diagram reveals filling-dependent topology: the $ρ=2/3$ regime remains in the $C=+2$ sector, while $ρ=4/3$ regime undergoes a spin-gap-closing transition from a $C=-2$ pump to a distinct $C=+1$ topological Mott pump.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：DMRG计算、多体Chern数、相图分析。；研究对象：论文研究的是相互作用驱动的多体Thouless泵浦，具体体系为周期为三的Hubbard链（填充率ρ=2/3和ρ=4/3），重点关注其边界谱流和边界激发模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在填充率ρ=2/3的周期三Hubbard链中，实现了多体Chern数C=+2的关联绝缘体泵浦，其边界谱流被相互作用分裂为两个不同的边缘事件，并在其间出现局域于边界的中性自旋三重态激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在填充率ρ=2/3的周期三Hubbard链中，实现了多体Chern数C=+2的关联绝缘体泵浦，其边界谱流被相互作用分裂为两个不同的边缘事件，并在其间出现局域于边界的中性自旋三重态激发。；创新点：首次在相互作用调制的Hubbard模型中展示了边界谱流被关联效应重构的现象，具体表现为自旋简并的边缘流被分裂，并产生了中性三重态边界模式。这揭示了超越简单自旋简并能带泵浦的相互作用体响应，并绘制了包含填充依赖拓扑相变的全局μ-U相图。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）数值计算方法，计算了体系的基态性质、激发谱（电荷隙与自旋隙）、多体Chern数以及开放边界条件下的边界谱流。同时，通过与自旋简并的Hartree/Aubry-André-Harper参考泵浦模型进行对比，揭示了相互作用的关键作用。

papers.title: Evidence of a Hybridized Topological State in Weyl Semimetal/Topological Insulator Mn$_{3+x}$Sn$_{1-x}$/Bi$_{0.85}$Sb$_{0.15}$ Heterostructures
papers.abstract: We report magnetotransport evidence of a hybridized Weyl semimetal (WSM) Fermi arc/topological insulator (TI) surface state at the interface of a ferromagnetic Mn$_{3+x}$Sn$_{1-x}$/Bi$_{0.85}$Sb$_{0.15}$ heterostructure. High target utilization sputtering (HiTUS) was used to grow polycrystalline Mn$_{3+x}$Sn$_{1-x}$ films and Mn$_{3+x}$Sn$_{1-x}$/Bi$_{0.85}$Sb$_{0.15}$ heterostructures on thermally oxidized Si/SiO$_2$ (100) substrates that exhibit the negative coefficient anomalous Hall effect (AHE) resulting from topological Weyl node transport. When various defects and impurities are introduced into these Mn$_{3+x}$Sn$_{1-x}$ films, a ferromagnetic (FM) phase develops that practically eliminates the topological Weyl node conduction. These FM Mn$_{3+x}$Sn$_{1-x}$ films exhibit large exchange bias effects below T=200 K that we attribute to the coexistence of a FM phase and the triangular antiferromagnetic (AFM) WSM phase. When Bi$_{0.85}$Sb$_{0.15}$ overlayers are grown on the FM Mn$_{3+x}$Sn$_{1-x}$, the magnetotransport signal of Weyl node topological transport is restored, an effect we do not observe when replacing the Bi$_{0.85}$Sb$_{0.15}$ TI with heavy metal overlayers. We attribute the restoration of the Weyl node topological transport to the formation of a hybridized topological state at the WSM/TI interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“magnetotransport evidence”、“High target utilization sputtering (HiTUS) was used to grow”、“magnetotransport signal”。；研究对象：铁磁性Weyl半金属Mn₃₊ₓSn₁₋ₓ与拓扑绝缘体Bi₀.₈₅Sb₀.₁₅构成的异质结，以及界面处杂化拓扑态的磁输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁性Mn₃₊ₓSn₁₋ₓ/Bi₀.₈₅Sb₀.₁₅异质结界面处，观测到了Weyl半金属费米弧与拓扑绝缘体表面态杂化形成的拓扑态，该杂化态恢复了因铁磁相出现而消失的Weyl节点拓扑输运信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁性Mn₃₊ₓSn₁₋ₓ/Bi₀.₈₅Sb₀.₁₅异质结界面处，观测到了Weyl半金属费米弧与拓扑绝缘体表面态杂化形成的拓扑态，该杂化态恢复了因铁磁相出现而消失的Weyl节点拓扑输运信号。；创新点：首次在实验上通过磁输运证据表明，在Weyl半金属/拓扑绝缘体异质结界面可形成杂化拓扑态，并能恢复被铁磁相抑制的Weyl节点拓扑输运，且该效应具有材料特异性（仅当覆盖层为拓扑绝缘体时出现）。
papers.method_zh: 采用高靶材利用率溅射（HiTUS）技术在热氧化Si/SiO₂(100)衬底上生长多晶Mn₃₊ₓSn₁₋ₓ薄膜及其与Bi₀.₈₅Sb₀.₁₅的异质结，通过磁输运测量（包括反常霍尔效应、交换偏置效应）分析拓扑输运行为，并对比了用重金属覆盖层替代Bi₀.₈₅Sb₀.₁₅的对照实验。

papers.title: Order-Disorder Tricriticality in $\mathrm{A}_n \mathrm{B}_n$ Star Polymer Melts
papers.abstract: Tricriticality usually requires tuning an additional thermodynamic parameter. Here we show that, in symmetric $\mathrm{A}_n\mathrm{B}_n$ star-polymer melts, the arm number $n$ itself plays this role and drives the order--disorder transition (ODT) from second order to first order. By developing a sixth-order free-energy expansion within the random phase approximation and comparing it with self-consistent field theory (SCFT) calculations, we analytically identify a tricritical arm number, $n_{\mathrm{tc}}\approx 5.4475$. For $n<n_{\mathrm{tc}}$, the lamellar ordering transition remains continuous and occurs at the spinodal point, $(χN)_{\mathrm{s}}\approx 10.495$. For $n>n_{\mathrm{tc}}$, the transition becomes first order, and $(χN)_{\mathrm{ODT}}$ shifts below $(χN)_{\mathrm{s}}$ with a quadratic dependence near the tricritical point. SCFT calculations confirm the predicted transition character and phase-boundary shift. The origin of this behavior is traced to inter-arm correlations generated by the common junction. We further show that the noninteger tricritical arm number can be effectively realized in binary mixtures of star polymers. This provides a rare analytically tractable example of architecture-induced tricriticality in a microphase-separating polymer system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：free-energy expansion, random phase approximation, self-consistent field theory calculations）；研究对象：对称型AₙBₙ星形聚合物熔体中的有序-无序转变（ODT）及其三临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 星形聚合物的臂数n本身可作为调控参数，驱动有序-无序转变从二级相变变为一级相变，并解析确定了三临界臂数n_tc≈5.4475。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：星形聚合物的臂数n本身可作为调控参数，驱动有序-无序转变从二级相变变为一级相变，并解析确定了三临界臂数n_tc≈5.4475。；创新点：首次在微相分离聚合物体系中，通过臂数这一架构参数实现无需额外热力学参数调谐的三临界性，并提供了解析可解的例子。摘要还指出，非整数三临界臂数可通过星形聚合物的二元混合物有效实现。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机相位近似（RPA）发展六阶自由能展开，并与自洽场理论（SCFT）计算结果进行对比分析。

papers.title: Kondo singlet from ferromagnetic coupling: an analog of Anderson-Morel superconductivity in the magnetic channel
papers.abstract: We consider magnetic impurities coupled to a conduction sea via a fully isotropic ferromagnetic spin-exchange term, the strength of which depends on the conduction-electron modes involved in the scattering. In the single-impurity case we show both analytically and numerically that there exists a parameter regime in which the conventional Kondo effect develops at low temperatures, leading to a singlet ground state. In the case of a lattice of impurities, we show that this leads to a heavy Fermi liquid state that is energetically favored over magnetic ordering in a broad parameter range. We argue that these effects are analogs of Anderson-Morel superconductivity, and discuss routes to their experimental realization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We consider、show analytically and numerically、argue、discuss routes。；研究对象：磁性杂质（单杂质及杂质晶格）与传导电子海通过完全各向同性的铁磁自旋交换耦合构成的系统。具体物理现象为铁磁耦合下的近藤效应及其导致的单态基态和重费米液体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在完全各向同性的铁磁自旋交换耦合下，只要耦合强度依赖于散射的传导电子模式，系统在低温下仍可发展出传统的近藤效应，形成单态基态。在杂质晶格情况下，这会形成一种在广泛参数范围内能量上优于磁有序的重费米液体态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在完全各向同性的铁磁自旋交换耦合下，只要耦合强度依赖于散射的传导电子模式，系统在低温下仍可发展出传统的近藤效应，形成单态基态。在杂质晶格情况下，这会形成一种在广泛参数范围内能量上优于磁有序的重费米液体态。；创新点：该工作揭示了在完全各向同性的铁磁耦合通道中，通过引入耦合强度对传导电子模式的依赖性，可以产生传统上仅与反铁磁耦合相关的近藤单态。这为理解磁性杂质系统提供了新的视角，并建立了与安德森-莫雷尔超导机制在磁通道中的类比。摘要未明确说明具体的数值计算方法（如是否使用NRG、DMRG等）。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（analytically）与数值计算（numerically）相结合。理论框架基于近藤模型，并类比了安德森-莫雷尔（Anderson-Morel）超导理论。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal conductance in uniformly dissipative devices
papers.abstract: When studying non-Hermitian electronic systems, an obvious question is how various non-Hermitian effects affect measurable quantities like the conductance. Here, we show that uniformly dissipative circuits can exhibit nonreciprocal conductance, meaning that the two nonlocal conductances are different. We describe how this happens through a difference in transmission times between left-moving and right-moving electrons. We consider a specific case of a dissipative Rashba nanowire with a skewed magnetic field, and show how this difference in transmission times comes about through interference inside the circuit, and how this is modified as the dissipation strength changes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-Hermitian electronic systems、show、describe、consider a specific case。；研究对象：均匀耗散电路中的非互易电导现象，具体以耗散Rashba纳米线在倾斜磁场中的体系为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 均匀耗散电路可以表现出非互易电导，即两个非局域电导值不同；该现象源于左移与右移电子传输时间之间的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：均匀耗散电路可以表现出非互易电导，即两个非局域电导值不同；该现象源于左移与右移电子传输时间之间的差异。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，通过考虑电路内部干涉效应以及耗散强度变化对传输时间差异的影响，具体以耗散Rashba纳米线在倾斜磁场中的模型为例进行说明。

papers.title: Graphene-based Photodetector with Engineered Hot Carrier Cooling Dynamics
papers.abstract: Graphene has emerged as a promising material for integration into silicon photonics, owing to its ultrafast and broadband photoresponse without the need for an external bias voltage. This photoresponse relies on the photo-thermoelectric effect created by hot carriers. A key factor underlying the performance of graphene photodetectors is the cooling dynamics of these hot carriers. In this work, we engineer these dynamics in a WSe2-graphene-WSe2 waveguide-integrated photodetector. In particular, by introducing proximity screening by a nearby graphite layer to this structure, we prolong the hot-carrier cooling time, leading to an enhanced photoresponse. We characterize the cooling dynamics under continuous-wave laser excitation by employing a photomixing technique, revealing an increase in the cooling time by up to a factor of four. Direct photoresponse measurements show that the internal photoresponsivity improves by approximately 50%. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of proximity screening to enhance the performance of graphene-based photodetectors on an integrated photonics platform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：characterize、measurements、demonstrate。；研究对象：WSe2-石墨烯-WSe2波导集成光电探测器中的热载流子冷却动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在WSe2-石墨烯-WSe2波导集成光电探测器附近引入石墨层进行邻近屏蔽，可将热载流子冷却时间延长至原来的四倍，并使内部光响应度提高约50%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在WSe2-石墨烯-WSe2波导集成光电探测器附近引入石墨层进行邻近屏蔽，可将热载流子冷却时间延长至原来的四倍，并使内部光响应度提高约50%。；创新点：首次利用邻近屏蔽效应调控石墨烯基光电探测器中热载流子的冷却动力学，从而在集成光子学平台上提升器件性能。
papers.method_zh: 采用光混频技术表征连续波激光激发下的冷却动力学，并进行直接光响应测量。

papers.title: Close correlation between giant magnetostriction and the microstructure in Fe-Ga melt-spun ribbons
papers.abstract: Magnetoelastic anisotropy and <100> texture are crucial for promoting magnetostriction in Galfenol (Fe-Ga). Given that single-crystal Fe-Ga remains technically demanding and low magnetostriction of polycrystal, we explore melt-spun as an alternative, where rare-earth (RE) doping and cooling rates optimizing enable controllable <100> textured with required magnetoelastic anisotropy. Fe81Ga19 binary ribbons and RE-doped ribbons (0.2 at.% Pr, 1 at.% Pr and 1 at.% Ce) were fabricated at various cooling rates. Microstructural analyses reveal that RE elements preferentially dissolve into the matrix, while second-phase formation is suppressed at higher cooling rates. RE substitution increases the magnetostriction by enhancing magnetocrystalline distortion energy, while cooling rates act as an effective tuning knob to maximize the <100> texture. Notably, the decreased melting temperature associated with 1 at.% RE doping shifts the optimum texture to lower cooling rate compared with the binary alloy and 0.2 at.% RE doping sample. The magnetostriction as high as 688 ppm is achieved for the 1 at.% Ce doped ribbon fabricated at the speed of 1000 rotation per minute. These results demonstrate that RE-doped melt-spun ribbons are promising candidates for giant magnetostriction and establish a practical processing-texture-property guideline for designing highly magnetostrictive alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了材料制备（melt-spun ribbons）、微结构分析（microstructural analyses）以及磁致伸缩性能测量（magnetostriction as high as 688 ppm）。；研究对象：Fe-Ga（Galfenol）熔纺薄带，具体包括Fe81Ga19二元合金以及掺杂稀土元素（Pr、Ce）的薄带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过稀土掺杂（如1 at.% Ce）和优化冷却速率，可在Fe-Ga熔纺薄带中实现高达688 ppm的巨磁致伸缩，且稀土掺杂通过增强磁晶畸变能提高磁致伸缩，冷却速率则有效调控<100>织构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过稀土掺杂（如1 at.% Ce）和优化冷却速率，可在Fe-Ga熔纺薄带中实现高达688 ppm的巨磁致伸缩，且稀土掺杂通过增强磁晶畸变能提高磁致伸缩，冷却速率则有效调控<100>织构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用熔纺（melt-spinning）技术制备薄带，通过改变冷却速率（如1000 rpm）和稀土掺杂（0.2 at.% Pr、1 at.% Pr、1 at.% Ce）进行样品制备；使用微结构分析（microstructural analyses）研究稀土元素分布和第二相形成；通过磁致伸缩测量评估性能。

papers.title: First-principles transition-state tensorial cluster expansion of vacancy diffusion in Ta-W beyond the kinetically-resolved activation approximation
papers.abstract: Predicting diffusion in chemically complex alloys remains challenging due to the strong dependence of migration barriers on local atomic environments. Here, we develop a first-principles-informed framework that directly learns environment-dependent migration barriers without relying on reduced kinetic approximations such as the kinetically resolved activation (KRA) model. Migration barriers computed using density functional theory and nudged elastic band calculations are represented via a tensorial cluster expansion including transition states and deployed in on-lattice kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. Applied to the Ta-W system, the framework captures nontrivial composition-dependent diffusion behavior arising from a crossover between solute trapping and percolated low-barrier transport pathways, yielding a maximum in the apparent activation energy near intermediate compositions. This approach establishes a general and scalable route for integrating first-principles transition-state energetics into mesoscale kinetic simulations, enabling predictive multiscale modeling of diffusion in chemically complex materials and providing a pathway for uncovering emergent transport phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“first-principles”、“density functional theory”、“nudged elastic band”、“cluster expansion”、“kinetic Monte Carlo simulations”。；研究对象：Ta-W合金中的空位扩散行为，具体研究迁移势垒对局域原子环境的依赖关系以及由此产生的成分依赖扩散特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ta-W合金中，由于溶质捕获与低势垒渗流输运路径之间的竞争，表观激活能在中间成分附近出现最大值，揭示了非平凡的成分依赖扩散行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ta-W合金中，由于溶质捕获与低势垒渗流输运路径之间的竞争，表观激活能在中间成分附近出现最大值，揭示了非平凡的成分依赖扩散行为。；创新点：直接学习环境依赖的迁移势垒，而不依赖简化的动力学近似（如动力学分辨激活模型，KRA），建立了从第一性原理过渡态能量到介观动力学模拟的通用可扩展框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理（密度泛函理论，DFT）和微动弹性带（NEB）方法计算迁移势垒，通过包含过渡态的张量团簇展开（tensorial cluster expansion）表示环境依赖的迁移势垒，并部署在晶格动力学蒙特卡洛（on-lattice kinetic Monte Carlo）模拟中。

papers.title: Disorder-Induced Phase Transitions in Altermagnetic Josephson Junctions
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic Josephson junctions (AMJJs) can host unconventional $π$ phase and $\varphi$ phase despite vanishing net magnetizations. Whether these phases are stable against disorder existing in real materials remains an open question. Here, we investigate impact of disorder on exotic phases in two-dimensional d-wave AMJJs. We show that disorder is able to induce phase transitions between the exotic $π$ and conventional 0 phases, accompanied by a strong suppression of critical current. This behavior is attributed to modifications of the tunneling Cooper-pair phase shift and superconducting decoherence. Remarkably, the anomalous $\varphi$ phase is highly fragile in presence of disorder and can be driven to either a $π$ phase or 0 phase in a nonreciprocal manner. Across such transitions, the first harmonic of current-phase relation changes sign, while the higher-order harmonics are rapidly suppressed. Our findings reveal the crucial role of disorder in tailoring distinct phases of AMJJs and shed new light on their potential functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“we investigate”“attributed to”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：二维d波交变磁约瑟夫森结（d-wave Altermagnetic Josephson Junctions, AMJJs）中的无序诱导相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序能够诱导交变磁约瑟夫森结中从奇异π相到常规0相的相变，并强烈抑制临界电流；反常φ相在无序下极不稳定，会以非互易方式转变为π相或0相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序能够诱导交变磁约瑟夫森结中从奇异π相到常规0相的相变，并强烈抑制临界电流；反常φ相在无序下极不稳定，会以非互易方式转变为π相或0相。；创新点：首次揭示了无序在调控交变磁约瑟夫森结中不同相（0相、π相、φ相）之间的转变中起关键作用，并指出φ相在无序下的高度脆弱性及非互易转变特性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：对二维d波AMJJs中无序效应的建模，分析隧穿库珀对相位移动和超导退相干机制，以及电流-相位关系中各阶谐波的变化。

papers.title: Momentum-Resolved Tunneling Modulation Induced Giant Multistate Resistance in Antiferroelectric Multiferroic Junction
papers.abstract: Multiferroic tunnel junctions (MFTJs), integrating ferroelectric and ferromagnetic functionalities within a single nanoscale device, hold significant promise for non-volatile, multi-state memory and innovative computing paradigms. In conventional MFTJs, tunneling resistance modulation relies primarily on ferroelectric (FE) polarization switching, which alters interfacial electric fields and shifts the Fermi level of adjacent ferromagnetic electrodes. However, achieving high tunnelelectroresistance (TER) through this approach demands strong built-in electric fields, which simultaneously hinder FE polarization switching, creating an intrinsic trade-off between reliable data reading and efficient writing. Here, we propose a dual mechanism that combines antiferroelectric (AFE) phase-transition modulation of the evanescent decay states with interfacial spin filtering based on $Fe_3GaTe_2$/bilayer-$In_2Se_3$/$Fe_3GaTe_2$ heterostructure. Beyond altering the electrostatic potential as in AFE-FE switching, the transitions between head-type and tail-type AFE states preserve the centrosymmetric potential profile yet fundamentally modulate the momentum-resolved distribution of evanescent decay rates across the Brillouin zone. When integrated with perfect spin filtering at the $Fe_3GaTe_2$/$α$-$In_2Se_3$ interface, this mechanism yields a giant TER (~$7.6\times10^3\%$), over 4 times that of conventional FE-based MFTJs, and a TMR exceeding $6.8\times10^5\%$, enhanced by two orders of magnitude over typical MFTJs. These mechanisms resolve the performance trade-off in MFTJs, enabling six distinct non-volatile resistance states at room temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验手段，主要基于“propose”和“yields”等理论预测性描述，涉及能带结构、隧穿电阻等计算分析。；研究对象：基于Fe₃GaTe₂/双层In₂Se₃/Fe₃GaTe₂异质结的反铁电多铁隧道结（MFTJ），具体研究其动量分辨隧穿调制与界面自旋过滤效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过反铁电（AFE）相变调制布洛赫波衰减态的动量分辨分布，结合Fe₃GaTe₂/α-In₂Se₃界面的完美自旋过滤，实现了巨隧穿电致电阻（TER~7.6×10³%）和隧穿磁电阻（TMR>6.8×10⁵%），并在室温下获得六种非易失电阻态，解决了传统MFTJ中读写性能的固有矛盾。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过反铁电（AFE）相变调制布洛赫波衰减态的动量分辨分布，结合Fe₃GaTe₂/α-In₂Se₃界面的完美自旋过滤，实现了巨隧穿电致电阻（TER~7.6×10³%）和隧穿磁电阻（TMR>6.8×10⁵%），并在室温下获得六种非易失电阻态，解决了传统MFTJ中读写性能的固有矛盾。；创新点：提出反铁电相变而非传统铁电极化翻转来调制隧穿电阻的新机制，该机制通过改变动量分辨的衰减态分布而非静电势，避免了强内建电场对极化翻转的抑制，从而同时实现高效写入与可靠读取。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理或量子输运理论计算（摘要未明确具体方法，如DFT或NEGF），分析头-尾型AFE态转变对布里渊区中衰减率动量分布的影响，并与界面自旋过滤效应结合计算TER和TMR。

papers.title: Phase diagram of the vortex state in an amorphous Re6Zr thin film exhibiting inverse melting
papers.abstract: In Type II superconductors, the vortex lattice can exhibit "inverse melting," transitioning from a liquid to a crystalline solid as temperature increases. While recently observed via scanning tunneling microscopy in a 20 nm thick amorphous Re6Zr thin film, this work investigates the corresponding d.c. transport and low-frequency magnetic screening responses. By identifying distinct signatures of these transitions and integrating scanning tunneling spectroscopy imaging, we construct a comprehensive vortex-state phase diagram in the magnetic field-temperature parameter space. Furthermore, we demonstrate that inverse melting is thickness-dependent: a 5 nm film retains an inhomogeneous liquid state, while a 50 nm film maintains a crystalline solid structure except near the upper critical field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：d.c. transport（直流输运）、low-frequency magnetic screening（低频磁屏蔽）、scanning tunneling spectroscopy imaging（扫描隧道谱成像）。；研究对象：非晶Re₆Zr薄膜中的涡旋态，特别是其“逆熔化”现象（即随温度升高从液态转变为晶态固体的相变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过输运和磁屏蔽测量，结合扫描隧道谱成像，构建了非晶Re₆Zr薄膜在磁场-温度参数空间中的完整涡旋态相图，并发现逆熔化现象具有厚度依赖性：5 nm薄膜保持非均匀液态，50 nm薄膜除上临界场附近外保持晶态固体结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过输运和磁屏蔽测量，结合扫描隧道谱成像，构建了非晶Re₆Zr薄膜在磁场-温度参数空间中的完整涡旋态相图，并发现逆熔化现象具有厚度依赖性：5 nm薄膜保持非均匀液态，50 nm薄膜除上临界场附近外保持晶态固体结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 直流输运测量、低频磁屏蔽响应测量、扫描隧道谱成像。

papers.title: Ambiguity in B-Site cation ordering: A Case study of the double perovskite Ca$_2$CoNbO$_6$
papers.abstract: The ordering of cations in the B sublattice remains a challenging issue in double perovskites. In this work, a combined experimental and theoretical approach was employed to investigate the Co/Nb distribution in Ca$_2$CoNbO$_6$ and its influence on magnetic and transport properties. The density functional theory, supported by magnetic susceptibility measurements, indicates that Co adopts a high-spin Co$^{3+}$ state. No long-range magnetic ordering was observed down to low temperatures; however, the presence of short-range correlations points to the partial disorder in the Co/Nb sublattice. This interpretation is further supported by electron paramagnetic resonance, which also reveals slight oxygen nonstoichiometry. Electrical transport follows a small-polaron hopping mechanism with an activation energy of 0.25 eV. The Seebeck coefficient reaches 0.4 mV/K at 600 K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。关键词：combined experimental and theoretical approach、density functional theory、magnetic susceptibility measurements、electron paramagnetic resonance。；研究对象：双钙钛矿材料 Ca₂CoNbO₆ 中 B 位阳离子（Co/Nb）的排布有序性及其对磁性和输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Co 以高自旋 Co³⁺ 态存在，体系未出现长程磁有序，但存在短程磁关联，表明 Co/Nb 亚晶格部分无序；电输运遵循小极化子跳跃机制，激活能为 0.25 eV，600 K 时塞贝克系数达 0.4 mV/K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Co 以高自旋 Co³⁺ 态存在，体系未出现长程磁有序，但存在短程磁关联，表明 Co/Nb 亚晶格部分无序；电输运遵循小极化子跳跃机制，激活能为 0.25 eV，600 K 时塞贝克系数达 0.4 mV/K。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、磁化率测量、电子顺磁共振（EPR）、电输运测量（电阻率与塞贝克系数）。

papers.title: Commensuration torques in double-moiré twisted trilayer hexagonal boron nitride and graphene heterostructures
papers.abstract: We study commensuration-driven torques and angle locking in double-moiré trilayer hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) and graphene heterostructures using large-scale atomistic relaxations. In twisted trilayer hBN (t3BN) homostructures, double-moiré commensuration ($θ_{12} = -θ_{23}$) give rise to local energy minima accompanied by torque sign reversals, signaling a restoring tendency toward the commensurate configuration. The corresponding binding energies are $\sim$0.2-0.3 meV/atom, originating from enhanced overlap of low-energy stacking domains, although the system is globally stable at zero twist. In contrast, in graphene/hBN heterolayers systems the global energy minimum can coincide with the double-moiré commensuration angle, particularly near $\sim$0.6$^{\circ}$, reflecting competition between lattice mismatch and interfacial relaxation. Incommensurate atomic structures have reduced stabilization due to suppressed overlap of low-energy stacking and have enhanced superlubricity due to spatial averaging of interfacial energies. These results establish double-moiré commensuration as a general, system-dependent mechanism for twist-angle stabilization, whose angular stability is characterized by the torque magnitude and binding energy. Coulomb electrostatic interactions further enhance the stabilization energy without changing the underlying physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“large-scale atomistic relaxations”（大规模原子弛豫模拟）。；研究对象：双莫尔扭曲三层六方氮化硼（t3BN）同质结构以及石墨烯/六方氮化硼（graphene/hBN）异质结构中的共度性驱动扭矩与角度锁定现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲三层六方氮化硼中，双莫尔共度性（θ₁₂ = -θ₂₃）导致局部能量极小值并伴随扭矩符号反转，表明系统有恢复至共度构型的趋势；而在石墨烯/六方氮化硼异质层中，全局能量最小值可与双莫尔共度角重合（约0.6°），反映了晶格失配与界面弛豫之间的竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲三层六方氮化硼中，双莫尔共度性（θ₁₂ = -θ₂₃）导致局部能量极小值并伴随扭矩符号反转，表明系统有恢复至共度构型的趋势；而在石墨烯/六方氮化硼异质层中，全局能量最小值可与双莫尔共度角重合（约0.6°），反映了晶格失配与界面弛豫之间的竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但该工作揭示了双莫尔共度性作为一种依赖于具体体系的、普适的扭转角稳定化机制，并通过扭矩大小和结合能来表征其角度稳定性。此外，库仑静电相互作用可进一步增强稳定化能而不改变底层物理。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模原子弛豫模拟（large-scale atomistic relaxations）进行计算研究。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium dynamics of high energy transitions in monolayer WSe$_{2}$
papers.abstract: High-energy optical transitions in monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides exhibit characteristics that are markedly distinct from those of lower-lying band-edge excitons. These differences arise from the involvement of electronic states located at regions of the Brillouin zone that are displaced from the $K$ valleys. In this work, we investigate the ultrafast dynamics of these high-energy excitations by employing broadband ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy spanning the visible to ultraviolet spectral range. We observe that the formation and relaxation dynamics of one of the high energy transitions display a distinct behavior compared to the lower-energy excitonic resonances, developing on a significantly slower timescale. First-principles calculations of the excitonic landscape allow us to account for this delayed response and attribute it to the phonon-mediated formation of momentum-dark excitons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：broadband ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy、ultrafast dynamics、first-principles calculations 辅助分析）；研究对象：单层过渡金属二硫族化物 WSe₂ 中的高能光学跃迁及其非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高能光学跃迁的形成与弛豫动力学显著慢于低能激子共振，这一延迟响应归因于声子介导的动量暗激子的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高能光学跃迁的形成与弛豫动力学显著慢于低能激子共振，这一延迟响应归因于声子介导的动量暗激子的形成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 宽带超快瞬态吸收光谱（覆盖可见光至紫外波段），结合第一性原理计算分析激子能谱。

papers.title: Intrinsic Point Defects and Frenkel Pair Formation in Photovoltaic Absorber Zn$_3$P$_2$: Regulating $p$-type Conductivity through Growth and Annealing Conditions
papers.abstract: This study investigates the ground-state energetics and thermodynamics of intrinsic point defects in zinc phosphide Zn$_3$P$_2$ using \emph{ab initio} density functional theory combined with an extensive potential energy landscape search. Our analysis reveals that the defect chemistry is dominated by zinc vacancies $V_\mathrm{Zn}$ and zinc interstitials Zn$_i$, with equilibrium concentrations significantly surpassing those of other intrinsic species. Notably, we find that phosphorus interstitials P$_i$, previously suggested to be significant, possess high formation energies and likely exist only in negligible quantities. The characteristic $p$-type conductivity of undoped Zn$_3$P$_2$ is shown to be a direct consequence of zinc vacancies, which act as shallow acceptors and pull the Fermi level toward the valence band. Furthermore, we identify a positive binding energy between $V_\mathrm{Zn}$ and Zn$_i$, leading to the formation of electrically benign Frenkel pairs that partially compensate the intrinsic p-type conductivity. Our results suggest that achieving $n$-type conductivity is fundamentally limited by these thermodynamic constraints. We conclude that hole densities can be optimized through phosphorus-rich growth conditions and high-temperature annealing, and suggest that future photovoltaic strategies should prioritize interface engineering over bulk $n$-type doping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用 *ab initio* density functional theory（第一性原理密度泛函理论）结合势能面搜索。；研究对象：光伏吸收材料磷化锌（Zn₃P₂）中的本征点缺陷及其热力学行为，特别是调控p型导电性的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Zn₃P₂的缺陷化学主要由锌空位（V_Zn）和锌间隙（Zn_i）主导，其中锌空位是浅受主，直接导致材料的p型导电性；而锌空位与锌间隙形成的弗仑克尔对（Frenkel pairs）是电中性的，会部分补偿本征p型导电性。实现n型导电性受到热力学限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Zn₃P₂的缺陷化学主要由锌空位（V_Zn）和锌间隙（Zn_i）主导，其中锌空位是浅受主，直接导致材料的p型导电性；而锌空位与锌间隙形成的弗仑克尔对（Frenkel pairs）是电中性的，会部分补偿本征p型导电性。实现n型导电性受到热力学限制。；创新点：否定了此前认为磷间隙（P_i）是重要缺陷的观点，首次明确揭示了锌空位与锌间隙之间的正结合能导致电中性弗仑克尔对的形成，并指出通过磷-rich生长条件和高温退火可优化空穴浓度，而体相n型掺杂受热力学限制，应优先考虑界面工程。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，并结合广泛的势能面搜索（potential energy landscape search）来研究本征点缺陷的基态能量和热力学性质。

papers.title: Self-organized formation of step-terrace structure in SrRuO3 thin films grown on mixed-terminated SrTiO3 (100) substrates
papers.abstract: Surface morphology of the substrate and bottom layers plays a critical role in the epitaxial growth of oxide thin films. Here, we report on the self-organized formation of a step-terrace structure in SrRuO3 (SRO) thin films grown using pulsed laser deposition on mixed-terminated SrTiO3 (100) substrates without any prior surface treatment. Atomic force microscopy observations reveal that SRO films initially grow in a three-dimensional island mode and subsequently undergo a transition to a step-flow growth mode through island coalescence as the film thickness increases, resulting in a well-defined step-terrace morphology with a step height consistent with the SRO unit-cell parameter. The average terrace width of the self-organized structure can be systematically tuned by varying the substrate temperature and the target-substrate distance, which we attribute to changes in the critical island radius that governs the nucleation behavior. To demonstrate the utility of this self-organized morphology, we show that BiFeO3 thin films grown on SRO films with such a step-terrace structure exhibit improved surface flatness and crystalline quality compared to those grown directly on bare SrTiO3 substrates. These findings provide a clear understanding of the mechanism of thickness-driven growth-mode transitions in perovskite oxide thin films under various growth conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Atomic force microscopy observations、pulsed laser deposition、growth。；研究对象：SrRuO₃ (SRO) 薄膜在混合终止的 SrTiO₃ (100) 衬底上自组织形成的台阶-平台结构，以及该结构对 BiFeO₃ 薄膜生长质量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在未经表面处理的混合终止 SrTiO₃ 衬底上，SrRuO₃ 薄膜随厚度增加从三维岛状生长模式转变为台阶流生长模式，自组织形成清晰的台阶-平台结构，且台阶高度与 SRO 单胞参数一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在未经表面处理的混合终止 SrTiO₃ 衬底上，SrRuO₃ 薄膜随厚度增加从三维岛状生长模式转变为台阶流生长模式，自组织形成清晰的台阶-平台结构，且台阶高度与 SRO 单胞参数一致。；创新点：首次报道在未进行任何表面预处理的混合终止 SrTiO₃ 衬底上，SrRuO₃ 薄膜能自组织形成台阶-平台结构，并系统揭示了生长条件（温度、靶-衬底距离）通过改变临界岛半径调控该结构的机制。
papers.method_zh: 脉冲激光沉积（PLD）生长薄膜，原子力显微镜（AFM）表征表面形貌，通过改变衬底温度和靶-衬底距离调控平均平台宽度。

papers.title: Symmetry-protected nodal planes and accidental nodal surfaces in mixed odd-even wave spin-momentum locking of relativistic altermagnets
papers.abstract: Non-relativistic spin--momentum locking in altermagnets exhibits an even number of nodal planes. In the relativistic limit, the number of nodal planes can be lowered by symmetry reduction due to the Néel vector and spin--orbit coupling in noncentrosymmetric systems. Therefore, an analysis of the evolution of the nodal planes in relativistic altermagnets is required. While $g$-wave spin--momentum locking is straightforward to realize in non-relativistic altermagnets, this $g$-wave does not necessarily survive in the relativistic case. In this work, we investigate the relativistic spin--momentum locking of the centrosymmetric CrSb and the noncentrosymmetric wurtzite MnTe. As a first result, we show that in both systems the dominant spin component retains its $g$-wave character in the relativistic regime only when the Néel vector is oriented along the $z$-axis, while the subdominant components exhibit $d$-wave symmetry in CrSb and $p$-wave symmetry in ferroelectric wurtzite MnTe. More generally, the $g$-wave character is preserved in the relativistic limit only when both the Néel vector and the electric field associated with inversion-symmetry breaking are oriented along the $z$-axis. As a second result, we show that relativistic spin--momentum locking of ferroelectric altermagnets can exhibit $p$-wave magnetism with one symmetry-protected nodal plane and an accidental nodal surface not protected by symmetry, or can have two accidental nodal surfaces. With the Néel vector aligned along the $x$-axis, selected bands of ferroelectric altermagnet wurtzite MnTe exhibit $p$-wave magnetism. Our results establish that altermagnets can host distinct spin components that realize a mixture of angular-momentum wave symmetries in momentum space in the relativistic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analysis、show、establish（理论分析与计算推导）。；研究对象：相对论性交变磁体（relativistic altermagnets）中的自旋-动量锁定（spin-momentum locking），具体材料包括中心对称的CrSb和非中心对称的纤锌矿MnTe。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相对论极限下，交变磁体的主导自旋分量仅在奈尔矢量沿z轴时保留g波特征，而次主导分量可呈现d波或p波对称性；非中心对称交变磁体可表现出p波磁性，具有一个对称保护的节面和一个偶然的节面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相对论极限下，交变磁体的主导自旋分量仅在奈尔矢量沿z轴时保留g波特征，而次主导分量可呈现d波或p波对称性；非中心对称交变磁体可表现出p波磁性，具有一个对称保护的节面和一个偶然的节面。；创新点：首次系统揭示了相对论交变磁体中不同自旋分量可混合不同角动量波对称性（如g波、d波、p波共存），并发现非中心对称交变磁体中存在p波磁性及偶然节面（accidental nodal surface）这一新现象。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析和能带结构计算，研究相对论自旋-动量锁定中节面（nodal planes）和节面（nodal surfaces）的演化，分析奈尔矢量方向与反演对称性破缺电场对自旋波对称性的影响。

papers.title: Analysis of spin avalanches due to interplay of disorder and temperature
papers.abstract: The nonequilibrium zero-temperature Random Field Ising Model (RFIM) has been extensively studied to understand critical response and avalanches in disordered driven systems. The emergence of power-law behaviour is observed over a wide region around the critical point. These studies however, are confined to zero-temperature dynamics. We study the role of temperature, which is inevitable in real experiments, in the context of RFIM on triangular lattices. We explore the interplay of different parameters: temperature, random field strength, and relaxation time which affect the prevalence of power-law behaviour on the lattice. The results indicate that power-law survives only in the regime of low temperature or small and intermediate disorder. Variations in temperature and disorder have similar affects on the avalanche-size distribution, indicating their strong correspondence. We also discuss the process of blurring out of the power law on increasing temperature or disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“零温随机场伊辛模型（RFIM）的数值研究”、“探索参数相互作用”，属于计算模拟与理论分析结合的类型。；研究对象：随机场伊辛模型（RFIM）在三角晶格上的非平衡动力学，具体研究温度、随机场强度与弛豫时间对雪崩行为（avalanches）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 幂律行为仅在低温或小到中等无序强度下存在；温度与无序强度对雪崩尺寸分布的影响具有相似性，表明两者之间存在强对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：幂律行为仅在低温或小到中等无序强度下存在；温度与无序强度对雪崩尺寸分布的影响具有相似性，表明两者之间存在强对应关系。；创新点：将传统局限于零温的RFIM雪崩研究拓展到有限温情形，系统揭示了温度与无序强度对幂律行为的等效影响，并讨论了温度或无序增加导致幂律模糊化的过程。
papers.method_zh: 基于随机场伊辛模型（RFIM）的数值模拟，在三角晶格上研究非零温动力学，通过改变温度、随机场强度和弛豫时间等参数，分析雪崩尺寸分布的幂律特征及其变化。

papers.title: Generalized Shift Vector as the Intrinsic Dipole of Many-Body Correlated Electronic States
papers.abstract: Shift vectors play a central role in nonlinear optics and transport phenomena, where they are usually understood as charge-center shifts associated with transitions between quantum states. Here we show that the same geometric structure can be more fundamentally understood as the intrinsic dipole moment of a single correlated state. Our derivation clarifies the local and global aspects of gauge invariance, the origin of the phase-gradient term, and its connection to the internal coherence structure of many-body correlations. The single-state shift character appears both as a displacement of the real-space joint probability density and as a linear electric-field modification in energy space. Applying this framework to optically induced correlations, electron-phonon-mediated processes, and excitonic electron-hole states, we recover previously proposed shift vectors and the standard expression for the shift current as special cases. Our results establish a common physical foundation for shift vectors as intrinsic dipolar properties of correlated electronic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derivation”（推导）、“framework”（理论框架）、“establish a common physical foundation”（建立共同物理基础）等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：多体关联电子态中广义位移矢量的内禀偶极性质，具体涉及光致关联、电子-声子介导过程以及激子电子-空穴态等体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了位移矢量（shift vector）可以更基本地理解为单个关联电子态的内禀偶极矩，而非仅与量子态间跃迁相关的电荷中心位移。该单态位移特征同时表现为实空间联合概率密度的位移和能量空间中的线性电场修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了位移矢量（shift vector）可以更基本地理解为单个关联电子态的内禀偶极矩，而非仅与量子态间跃迁相关的电荷中心位移。该单态位移特征同时表现为实空间联合概率密度的位移和能量空间中的线性电场修正。；创新点：将位移矢量从传统的跃迁关联几何量重新定义为单个关联态的内禀偶极性质，并统一解释了此前提出的各类位移矢量（如光致、电子-声子、激子体系）及位移电流的标准表达式。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。通过分析规范不变性的局域与全局方面、相位梯度项的起源及其与多体关联内部相干结构的联系，建立统一理论框架。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal surface tension: anisotropy-induced defect motility and organization
papers.abstract: We show that interfacial nonreciprocity transforms defect dynamics in conserved scalar fields within the framework of the Nonreciprocal Cahn-Hilliard model. Nonreciprocal surface tension alone produces intermittently stable defects: system-spanning target patterns form, lose stability, self-destruct, and nucleate again from a defect-chaotic state. When bulk and interfacial contributions interplay in a particular way, the system forms a distinct mosaic-wave state: traveling waves remain coherent within finite domains demarcated by linear arrangements of motile dislocations, which act as lines of phase slip. Mosaic-waves exhibit scale-free fluctuations at length scales much larger than the average wavelength of the traveling patterns. To explain the wide range of emergent dynamics, we construct the dynamics of the Goldstone-mode. The nonlinearities governing its large-scale fluctuations belong to the anisotropic Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class, with the sign of the nonlinear anisotropy controlling the nature of the out-of-equilibrium dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“We show”、“we construct”等理论推导和模型构建的表述，并涉及“universality class”等理论物理概念。；研究对象：非互易Cahn-Hilliard模型框架下，具有非互易表面张力的守恒标量场中的缺陷动力学。具体物理现象包括：靶向斑图、缺陷混沌态、以及一种新颖的“马赛克波”态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易表面张力本身即可导致间歇性稳定的缺陷（靶向斑图的自毁与重生）。当体相与界面贡献以特定方式相互作用时，系统会形成一种由移动位错（相滑移线）分隔的、具有尺度不变涨落的“马赛克波”态。该系统的长波涨落动力学属于各向异性Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易表面张力本身即可导致间歇性稳定的缺陷（靶向斑图的自毁与重生）。当体相与界面贡献以特定方式相互作用时，系统会形成一种由移动位错（相滑移线）分隔的、具有尺度不变涨落的“马赛克波”态。该系统的长波涨落动力学属于各向异性Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）普适类。；创新点：揭示了非互易表面张力（而非通常的体非互易性）是驱动缺陷复杂动力学（如靶向斑图的间歇性行为）的根源。首次报道了“马赛克波”这一由移动位错分隔的相干行波态，并指出其大尺度涨落具有尺度不变性，且属于各向异性KPZ普适类。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型构建。具体采用了非互易Cahn-Hilliard模型，并构建了Goldstone模的动力学方程，通过分析其非线性项归属到各向异性KPZ普适类来解释涌现动力学。

papers.title: Localized Excitonic Emission in Wafer-Scale MOCVD-Grown GaSe 2D Nanosheets for Classical and Non-Classical Light Sources
papers.abstract: Wafer-scale growth of two-dimensional semiconductors remains a key challenge for their integration into photonic technologies. While most studies of two-dimensional semiconductors have focused on transition metal dichalcogenides and their scalable fabrication, comparatively little attention has been given to III-VI monochalcogenides. Here, we report wafer-scale growth of gallium selenide (GaSe) by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) and investigate its structural and optical properties for visible-range classical and quantum light emission. Two samples with thicknesses ranging from a few monolayers to several micrometers, controlled via the growth time, were investigated. The 30-minute grown sample yields intense, broad photoluminescence spanning 1.7--2.0$\,$eV, whereas the thinner 3-minute sample exhibits discrete narrow emission lines and single-photon emission with $(g^{(2)}(0) = 0.15 \pm 0.10)$. Remarkably, cathodoluminescence mapping reveals pronounced spatial localization of both spectrally narrow and broad emission centers. Together with temperature-dependent power-law analysis and Raman mapping, our results indicate defect-induced emission rather than intrinsic excitonic recombination. These findings establish wafer-scale MOCVD grown 2D GaSe as a platform for classical and non-classical light sources and highlight defect-engineered localization as a route toward scalable quantum photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：MOCVD生长、光致发光、阴极发光、拉曼映射、单光子发射测量。；研究对象：二维硒化镓（GaSe）纳米片，具体为通过金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）在晶圆尺度上生长的III-VI族单硫族化物半导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MOCVD生长的晶圆级GaSe纳米片中，观测到局域化的激子发射，其中薄样品（3分钟生长）展现出离散窄线发射和单光子发射（g²(0)=0.15±0.10），且所有发射均源于缺陷诱导而非本征激子复合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MOCVD生长的晶圆级GaSe纳米片中，观测到局域化的激子发射，其中薄样品（3分钟生长）展现出离散窄线发射和单光子发射（g²(0)=0.15±0.10），且所有发射均源于缺陷诱导而非本征激子复合。；创新点：首次在晶圆级MOCVD生长的二维GaSe中同时实现经典（宽谱）与非经典（单光子）光源，并明确将局域化发射归因于缺陷工程而非本征激子，为可扩展量子光子学提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）生长；光致发光（PL）光谱；阴极发光（CL）成像与映射；温度依赖的幂律分析；拉曼映射；二阶关联函数g²(0)测量。

papers.title: Selective Fermi-Level Pinning: A Design Strategy for Giant Rectification in Molecular Junctions
papers.abstract: Molecular rectifiers are key functional components of molecular-scale integrated circuits, yet achieving high rectification ratios remains a longstanding challenge due to the intrinsic symmetry of resonant tunneling and the complexity of interfacial energy-level alignment. Here, we propose a rectifier design strategy based on selective Fermi-level pinning that breaks transport symmetry via pinning interactions between molecular frontier orbitals and electrodes. This framework enforces tunneling transport to be predominantly governed by unoccupied molecular orbitals, while substantially suppressing contributions from occupied states, thereby establishing a simplified and highly controllable rectification mechanism. The resulting cyclo[n]carbon-based molecular junctions exhibit giant rectification ratios exceeding 103, while retaining exceptional structural robustness against variations in both donor chain length and carbon ring size. This work reveals the critical role of selective Fermi-level pinning in molecular junctions and provides a general design principle for engineering functional single-molecule electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：propose a rectifier design strategy、framework、design principle。；研究对象：分子整流器（molecular rectifiers），具体为基于环[n]碳（cyclo[n]carbon）的分子结（molecular junctions），以及其中的选择性费米能级钉扎（selective Fermi-level pinning）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择性费米能级钉扎打破输运对称性，使隧穿输运主要由未占据分子轨道主导，从而在环[n]碳分子结中实现了超过10³的巨整流比，且对分子结构变化（如给体链长和碳环尺寸）具有优异的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择性费米能级钉扎打破输运对称性，使隧穿输运主要由未占据分子轨道主导，从而在环[n]碳分子结中实现了超过10³的巨整流比，且对分子结构变化（如给体链长和碳环尺寸）具有优异的鲁棒性。；创新点：提出了一种基于选择性费米能级钉扎的通用整流设计策略，区别于传统依赖共振隧穿对称性破缺的方法，实现了高度可控且结构鲁棒的巨整流效应。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或计算方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于选择性费米能级钉扎的整流器设计策略，通过分子前线轨道与电极之间的钉扎相互作用来调控界面能级对齐，从而控制隧穿输运机制。

papers.title: Inviscid scaling in the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation from functional renormalization group and direct numerical simulations
papers.abstract: We show that the one-dimensional Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation features a scaling regime characterized by the dynamical exponent $z=1$ at intermediate scales between the large-scale Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) scaling with $z=3/2$ and the small-scale non-universal behavior. This scaling regime is intrinsic to the KS dynamics since it arises from the vanishing of the effective viscosity when evolving from its microscopic negative KS value, to its macroscopic effective positive KPZ value. This vanishing of the viscosity deeply imprints the behavior of correlations at intermediate scales, which exhibit a universal $z=1$ scaling. This behavior pertains to the inviscid-Burgers universality class, which corresponds to the zero-viscosity fixed point of the KPZ equation. We evidence and characterize this so-far-overlooked scaling regime using both functional renormalization group and direct numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合数值计算）。判断依据：functional renormalization group（泛函重整化群）、direct numerical simulations（直接数值模拟）。；研究对象：一维Kuramoto-Sivashinsky（KS）方程中的标度行为，具体关注其介于大尺度KPZ标度与小尺度非普适行为之间的中间标度区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: KS方程在中间尺度存在一个动力学指数z=1的标度区，该标度源于有效黏度从微观负值向宏观正KPZ值演化过程中的消失，属于无黏Burgers普适类（即KPZ方程的零黏度不动点）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：KS方程在中间尺度存在一个动力学指数z=1的标度区，该标度源于有效黏度从微观负值向宏观正KPZ值演化过程中的消失，属于无黏Burgers普适类（即KPZ方程的零黏度不动点）。；创新点：首次发现并表征了KS方程中此前被忽视的z=1中间标度区，并指出其属于无黏Burgers普适类。
papers.method_zh: 泛函重整化群（functional renormalization group）理论分析，以及直接数值模拟（direct numerical simulations）。

papers.title: Field evolution of the magnetic structure and spin Hamiltonian in Cs$_2$RuO$_4$
papers.abstract: We report neutron diffraction under applied magnetic fields and complementary zero-field neutron spectroscopy measurements on Cs$_2$RuO$_4$. Previous work [Phys. Rev. B. 112, 134436 (2025)] identified a spin-flop-like transition accompanied by a quantum critical point within the ordered phase, attributed to strong frustration between alternating single-ion anisotropy planes. Here, we quantitatively confirm the predicted field evolution of the magnetic structure using neutron diffraction. Furthermore, analysis of the excitation spectrum within an SU(3) spin-wave framework resolves previously undetermined parameters of the minimal spin Hamiltonian and lifts the associated degeneracies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：neutron diffraction、neutron spectroscopy measurements）；研究对象：Cs₂RuO₄ 单晶在磁场下的磁结构演化及其自旋哈密顿量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中子衍射定量证实了先前理论预测的磁结构随磁场的演化，并利用 SU(3) 自旋波框架解析了最小自旋哈密顿量中此前未确定的参数，消除了相关简并。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中子衍射定量证实了先前理论预测的磁结构随磁场的演化，并利用 SU(3) 自旋波框架解析了最小自旋哈密顿量中此前未确定的参数，消除了相关简并。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 应用外加磁场下的中子衍射实验，以及零场中子谱学测量；理论分析采用 SU(3) 自旋波框架。

papers.title: A Metadynamics-Based Framework for Free Energy Surface Mapping of Multiparticle Diffusion in Crystals
papers.abstract: We propose two metadynamics (MetaD)-based methodologies for efficiently mapping free energy surfaces (FESs) of multiple interacting carriers diffusing in crystalline solids. Our approaches circumvent the challenges of high-dimensional collective variables (CVs) by employing replica state exchange MetaD and parallel bias MetaD, both of which decompose the high-dimensional CVs into multiple lower-dimensional ones. As a benchmark, we investigate two-dimensional lithium (Li) diffusion in LixTiS2 across a wide range of Li concentrations. The Li jump frequencies estimated from the obtained FESs exhibit concentration- and temperature-dependent trends consistent with previous kinetic Monte Carlo simulations and nuclear magnetic resonance measurements. Our approaches provide a promising framework for capturing the slow dynamics of diffusive carriers that are typically inaccessible to conventional molecular dynamics simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：metadynamics (MetaD)、free energy surfaces (FESs)、molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：多粒子（载流子）在晶体中的扩散现象，具体以锂离子（Li）在LixTiS2中的二维扩散为基准体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的两种基于metadynamics的方法能够高效地绘制多相互作用载流子在晶体中扩散的自由能面，且从所得自由能面估算的锂离子跳跃频率呈现与先前动力学蒙特卡洛模拟和核磁共振测量一致的浓度和温度依赖趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的两种基于metadynamics的方法能够高效地绘制多相互作用载流子在晶体中扩散的自由能面，且从所得自由能面估算的锂离子跳跃频率呈现与先前动力学蒙特卡洛模拟和核磁共振测量一致的浓度和温度依赖趋势。；创新点：提出了一种能够捕捉传统分子动力学模拟通常无法访问的扩散载流子慢动力学的框架，通过分解高维集体变量实现了对多粒子扩散自由能面的高效映射。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种metadynamics变体方法：副本状态交换metadynamics（replica state exchange MetaD）和并行偏置metadynamics（parallel bias MetaD），通过将高维集体变量分解为多个低维集体变量来规避高维挑战。

papers.title: Cathodoluminescence Analysis of Defects and Grain Boundaries in Zn3P2 Thin Films Grown on Graphene by MOVPE and MBE
papers.abstract: Zn3P2 is a promising earth-abundant absorber for thin-film photovoltaics, yet its development is hindered by the lack of lattice-matched substrates, its incompatible thermal expansion coefficient, and a complex defect landscape. Here, we demonstrate the quasi-van der Waals epitaxy of Zn3P2 on graphene by metal-organic vapour phase epitaxy (MOVPE) and directly link the density of antiphase boundaries to optical emission modulation using correlative electron microscopy and cathodoluminescence (CL). Moreover, it is observed through CL that grain boundaries act as non-radiative sinks for excited charge carriers. The effect extends several micrometres into the grains, making grain boundaries detrimental to the applicability of Zn3P2 in read devices. Further comparison with molecular beam epitaxy grown films reveals the suppression of strain-related sub-bandgap emission in MOVPE-grown material. Overall, quasi-van der Waals epitaxy of Zn3P2 by MOVPE resulted in larger grains and improved material quality. In addition, these results directly link extended defects to recombination pathways in Zn3P2 and highlight grain-size control as a key strategy for improving earth-abundant photovoltaic absorbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“correlative electron microscopy and cathodoluminescence (CL)”、“metal-organic vapour phase epitaxy (MOVPE)”、“molecular beam epitaxy (MBE)”等实验手段。；研究对象：Zn₃P₂薄膜在石墨烯衬底上的准范德华外延生长，重点研究其缺陷（反相边界）和晶界对光学性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Zn₃P₂薄膜中反相边界的密度与光学发射调制直接相关；晶界作为非辐射复合中心，其影响可延伸至晶粒内部数微米，对器件应用有害。MOVPE生长的薄膜相比MBE具有更大晶粒和更高质量，且抑制了应变相关的亚带隙发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Zn₃P₂薄膜中反相边界的密度与光学发射调制直接相关；晶界作为非辐射复合中心，其影响可延伸至晶粒内部数微米，对器件应用有害。MOVPE生长的薄膜相比MBE具有更大晶粒和更高质量，且抑制了应变相关的亚带隙发射。；创新点：首次将Zn₃P₂中反相边界等扩展缺陷与复合路径直接关联，并定量揭示了晶界对载流子非辐射复合的空间影响范围，同时对比了MOVPE与MBE两种生长方法对材料质量的影响。
papers.method_zh: 金属有机气相外延（MOVPE）和分子束外延（MBE）生长Zn₃P₂薄膜；关联电子显微镜与阴极发光（CL）光谱技术进行表征。

papers.title: Studying Creep-Fatigue interaction of Nickel-Based Superalloys using Crystal Plasticity and Entropy-Based life prediction model
papers.abstract: Creep-fatigue interaction in single-crystal nickel superalloys is difficult to predict because the response depends on the combined effects of loading parameters, hold time, temperature, and the underlying deformation mechanisms. This is important for turbine blade applications, where components experience both fatigue and creep during service. In the present work, a crystal plasticity finite element (CPFE) framework is used to study the creep-fatigue response of a single-crystal nickel superalloy under a range of practically relevant thermo-mechanical loading conditions. In particular, the effects of strain amplitude, R-ratio, hold duration, and temperature on cyclic deformation, stress relaxation, damage evolution, and creep-fatigue life are examined. Particular attention is given to separate the roles of fatigue and creep damage, understanding their interaction, and identify the creep-dominated and fatigue-dominated regimes as a function of strain amplitude and hold time. The study brings together these effects within a single framework and shows that the predicted trends in cyclic response and life are in good agreement with experimental observations reported in the literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：crystal plasticity finite element (CPFE) framework、framework、predicted trends）；研究对象：单晶镍基高温合金的蠕变-疲劳交互作用（creep-fatigue interaction），具体涉及涡轮叶片服役条件下的热-机械加载响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过晶体塑性有限元框架，成功分离了疲劳损伤与蠕变损伤的贡献，识别出随应变幅值和保载时间变化的蠕变主导与疲劳主导区域，且预测的循环响应和寿命趋势与文献实验观测吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过晶体塑性有限元框架，成功分离了疲劳损伤与蠕变损伤的贡献，识别出随应变幅值和保载时间变化的蠕变主导与疲劳主导区域，且预测的循环响应和寿命趋势与文献实验观测吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 晶体塑性有限元（CPFE）框架，用于模拟不同应变幅值、R-比、保载时长和温度下的循环变形、应力松弛、损伤演化及蠕变-疲劳寿命。

papers.title: Orientational frustration drives enhanced diffusion of anisotropic particles in a liquid labyrinth
papers.abstract: Transport of nanoscale objects in complex, structured environments plays a key role in a wide range of processes, from biomolecular dynamics in extracellular spaces to transport in porous materials such as filters and catalysts. While anomalous diffusion is well established, how particle anisotropy governs transport under geometric constraints remains unclear. Here we use 3D single-particle tracking to investigate the diffusion of stiff one-dimensional carbon nanotubes in a continuous soft matter network of interconnected chambers and constrictions. Transport is anomalous and antipersistent, with strong length dependent confinement and trapping, consistent with obstructed diffusion. Unexpectedly, however, escape from confinement is poorly sensitive to nanotube length as opposed to what would be expected of pore mediated transport. Despite a tenfold length increase and significantly enhanced trapping, escape time increased by only ~1.4. Single-particle orientational tracking reveals the origin of this weak scaling. Indeed, long nanotube, i.e. those with length comparable to the chamber dimensions, dynamically align with constrictions enabling efficient, geometry-assisted escape that offsets increased confinement while shorter nanotubes need to screen the volume to find their escape path. These results uncover an alignment-mediated transport mechanism that decouples confinement strength from escape kinetics, distinct from pore-mediated transport mechanisms, establishing a quantitative framework for anisotropic diffusion in complex environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：3D single-particle tracking（三维单粒子追踪实验）。；研究对象：各向异性粒子（刚性一维碳纳米管）在连续软物质网络（由相互连通的腔室和收缩通道构成的“液体迷宫”）中的扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长碳纳米管（长度与腔室尺寸相当）会动态对齐于收缩通道，实现几何辅助的逃逸，从而显著弱化逃逸时间对长度的依赖（长度增加10倍，逃逸时间仅增加约1.4倍），揭示了一种与孔隙介导输运不同的对齐介导输运机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长碳纳米管（长度与腔室尺寸相当）会动态对齐于收缩通道，实现几何辅助的逃逸，从而显著弱化逃逸时间对长度的依赖（长度增加10倍，逃逸时间仅增加约1.4倍），揭示了一种与孔隙介导输运不同的对齐介导输运机制。；创新点：发现了各向异性粒子在几何约束环境中通过动态取向对齐实现高效逃逸的新机制，该机制将约束强度与逃逸动力学解耦，区别于传统的孔隙介导输运模型。
papers.method_zh: 三维单粒子追踪技术，用于实时追踪不同长度碳纳米管在软物质网络中的扩散轨迹、取向及逃逸动力学。

papers.title: Memory-driven topological ordering during the transition from dormant to migrating epithelia
papers.abstract: Transitions from quiescence to collective migration in epithelia underlie wound healing and cancer invasion, yet their physical origin remains poorly understood. Here we show that quiescent epithelial monolayers store spatially contractile stresses that function as a form of mechanical memory. Upon serum-induced reactivation, these pre-stressed regions nucleate extensile asters that emit propagating polarity domain walls. Along these interfaces, topological defects are created, advected and annihilated, leading to defect coarsening with faster kinetics than by elastic interactions. An active elastic model quantitatively reproduces the observed dynamics and identifies stored stress as the origin of rapid topological reorganization. Our results establish a mechanism in which mechanical memory in quiescent epithelia triggers active stress release, driving collective migration via rapid topological ordering, distinct from conventional unjamming and flocking transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：实验观测（“show that quiescent epithelial monolayers store spatially contractile stresses”）结合理论建模（“An active elastic model quantitatively reproduces the observed dynamics”）。；研究对象：上皮组织从静止态到集体迁移的转变过程，具体涉及伤口愈合和癌症侵袭中的机械记忆与拓扑缺陷动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静止上皮单层中储存的空间收缩应力构成一种机械记忆；血清激活后，这些预应力区域会引发快速拓扑有序化，驱动集体迁移，其机制不同于传统的解堵塞或群集转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静止上皮单层中储存的空间收缩应力构成一种机械记忆；血清激活后，这些预应力区域会引发快速拓扑有序化，驱动集体迁移，其机制不同于传统的解堵塞或群集转变。；创新点：揭示了静止上皮中的机械记忆作为主动应力释放的触发因素，通过快速拓扑有序化（而非弹性相互作用主导的粗化）驱动集体迁移，区别于传统的unjamming和flocking转变机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过血清诱导上皮单层再激活，观测应力释放、极性畴壁传播及拓扑缺陷的成核、输运与湮灭；理论上采用主动弹性模型定量复现动力学过程，并识别储存应力为快速拓扑重组的起源。

papers.title: Thermodynamic stability of twisted domains in AgCrSe$_{2}$ thin films grown on lattice-matched YSZ(111) substrate
papers.abstract: Control of structural domains in epitaxial thin films of functional materials is a fundamental technique to utilize their intrinsic physical and chemical properties in solid-state devices. In this study, we report on suppression of twisted-domain formation in thin-film growth of polar magnetic semiconductor AgCrSe$_{2}$ using pulsed-laser deposition. In exploring concomitant optimized growth temperature and Ag/Cr composition ratio of supply, we find the critical growth temperature ($T\mathrm{_{sub}}$) for obtaining single 60$^{\circ}$ domain in c-axis oriented AgCrSe$_{2}$ thin film on a lattice-matched (111) plane of the yttria-stabilized zirconia substrate. At temperatures below and above the critical $T\mathrm{_{sub}}$, metastable 0$^{\circ}$ domain in addition to the 60$^{\circ}$ domain emerges, indicating delicate energy balance of thermodynamic stability for obtaining the single-domain structure. Surface structural analysis using time-of-flight low-energy atom scattering spectroscopy reveals the presence of two polar orientations along $+Z$ and $-Z$ directions. These findings provide valuable insights into the thin-film growth mechanisms for a family of two-dimensional compounds with rhombohedral lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用脉冲激光沉积（pulsed-laser deposition）”、“表面结构分析使用飞行时间低能原子散射谱（time-of-flight low-energy atom scattering spectroscopy）”。；研究对象：极性磁性半导体AgCrSe₂薄膜在晶格匹配的YSZ(111)衬底上生长时形成的扭转畴（twisted domains）的热力学稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在晶格匹配的YSZ(111)衬底上生长c轴取向的AgCrSe₂薄膜时，存在一个临界生长温度（T_sub），在此温度下可获得单一的60°畴；低于或高于该临界温度时，会额外出现亚稳态的0°畴，表明单畴结构的热力学稳定性存在微妙的能量平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在晶格匹配的YSZ(111)衬底上生长c轴取向的AgCrSe₂薄膜时，存在一个临界生长温度（T_sub），在此温度下可获得单一的60°畴；低于或高于该临界温度时，会额外出现亚稳态的0°畴，表明单畴结构的热力学稳定性存在微妙的能量平衡。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 脉冲激光沉积（PLD）生长薄膜；通过优化生长温度和Ag/Cr组分比来探索生长条件；使用飞行时间低能原子散射谱（TOF-LEAS）进行表面结构分析，以识别沿+Z和-Z方向的两种极性取向。

papers.title: In situ estimation of local acoustic pressure amplitude by force balancing with a ferrofluid droplet probe
papers.abstract: Acoustic tweezers enable non-contact manipulation of microscale objects, but quantitative in situ evaluation of the peak local pressure amplitude remains difficult in confined devices. Conventional hydrophone-based measurements are often limited at the microscale by probe size and installation constraints. Here, we present a force-balance method in which a trapped ferrofluid droplet serves as a local probe in a standing-wave acoustic field and an externally applied magnetic-field gradient is tuned so that the magnetic force balances the maximum primary acoustic radiation force on the droplet. From the magnetic force on the ferrofluid droplet, determined at the balance point, we estimate a peak local pressure amplitude of $2.6\times10^{5}$~Pa for 7.2~MHz operation at 10~V$_{\mathrm{pp}}$. This approach provides a practical route for quantitative in situ characterization of microscale acoustic fields and for setting operating conditions in compact acoustofluidic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验方法（force-balance method）和实验测量（magnetic force on ferrofluid droplet），并给出了定量结果（压力幅值）。；研究对象：声学镊子（acoustic tweezers）中驻波声场的局部声压幅值，以及用于探测该声压的铁磁流体液滴（ferrofluid droplet）探针。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过力平衡法，利用铁磁流体液滴作为局域探针，结合外加磁场梯度，成功估计出在7.2 MHz、10 Vpp工作条件下，峰值局部声压幅值为2.6×10^5 Pa。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过力平衡法，利用铁磁流体液滴作为局域探针，结合外加磁场梯度，成功估计出在7.2 MHz、10 Vpp工作条件下，峰值局部声压幅值为2.6×10^5 Pa。；创新点：提出了一种在受限微尺度器件中定量原位表征局部声压幅值的实用方法，克服了传统水听器在微尺度下因探头尺寸和安装限制而难以测量的困难。
papers.method_zh: 力平衡法：在驻波声场中捕获铁磁流体液滴作为局域探针，通过调节外加磁场梯度，使磁力与液滴上的最大主声辐射力平衡，从而根据平衡点的磁力估算局部声压幅值。

papers.title: Quantum fluctuations in quartet superfluid of two-dimensional Fermi mixture
papers.abstract: We study quantum fluctuations in quartet superfluid (QSF) of two-dimensional (2D) fermion mixtures with mass imbalance. Here QSF is a high-order superfluid that corresponds to the condensation of ($1+3$) clusters, each consisting of a light fermion and three heavy ones. By incorporating the Gaussian fluctuations respecting dominant four-body correlations in this system, our theory successfully produces the logarithmic dependence of the 2D equation of state in the deep binding regime, thereby offering a correct physical picture of quartet clusters behaving as composite bosons. By extending the Gaussian fluctuation theory from pairing to quartet superfluids, our results shed light on quantum fluctuations in general fermion superfluids with arbitrarily high-order correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“we study”“our theory”“extending the Gaussian fluctuation theory”等表述，未提及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：二维费米混合物中的四重态超流（quartet superfluid, QSF），具体为质量不平衡的二维费米子混合物中由（1+3）团簇（一个轻费米子与三个重费米子）凝聚形成的高阶超流相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在深束缚极限下，该理论成功给出了二维状态方程的对数依赖关系，从而提供了四重态团簇作为复合玻色子的正确物理图像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在深束缚极限下，该理论成功给出了二维状态方程的对数依赖关系，从而提供了四重态团簇作为复合玻色子的正确物理图像。；创新点：将高斯涨落理论从传统的配对超流扩展至四重态超流，为研究具有任意高阶关联的费米子超流中的量子涨落提供了新框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用高斯涨落理论，将系统的主导四体关联纳入考虑，并将该理论从配对超流推广至四重态超流，以研究任意高阶关联的费米子超流中的量子涨落。

papers.title: Exact solution of generalized gauge-invariant Ising chains with multi-spin interactions
papers.abstract: In this work, exact solutions are obtained for a class of generalized gauge-invariant $n$-chain Ising models ($n=1,2,3,4$) with arbitrary multi-spin interactions that are invariant under the local $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge group. On a strip lattice of finite length $L$ and width $n$ with periodic or free boundary conditions, an explicit expression for the partition function is derived using the transfer-matrix method. Two successive transformations are developed: elimination of gauge redundancy and reduction of the original model to an effective $n$-chain Ising model with all possible interactions between neighboring vertical layers. On the basis of the spectral decomposition of the $2^n\times 2^n$ transfer matrix, general formulas are obtained for gauge-invariant correlation functions and Wilson loops of arbitrary width. For $n \le 3$, explicit expressions are derived in terms of eigenvalues and eigenvectors. A detailed analysis of the behavior of the Wilson loop is performed, which allows us to identify regimes exhibiting area-law (confinement-like) and perimeter-law (deconfinement-like) dependence. For specific Hamiltonians, the string tension is computed and the corresponding phase diagrams are constructed. The results generalize and substantially extend the classical works on the gauge-invariant Ising model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution、transfer-matrix method、spectral decomposition。；研究对象：一类具有任意多自旋相互作用的广义规范不变n链伊辛模型（n=1,2,3,4），在有限长、宽为n的条状晶格上，具有周期或自由边界条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解，识别出Wilson圈呈现面积律（类似禁闭相）和周长律（类似退禁闭相）依赖性的不同行为区域，并计算了特定哈密顿量下的弦张力，构建了相应的相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解，识别出Wilson圈呈现面积律（类似禁闭相）和周长律（类似退禁闭相）依赖性的不同行为区域，并计算了特定哈密顿量下的弦张力，构建了相应的相图。；创新点：将经典规范不变伊辛模型的研究推广到具有任意多自旋相互作用的广义n链情形（n=1,2,3,4），并给出了精确解。摘要未突出说明与经典工作的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 转移矩阵方法。具体包括：通过两次连续变换（消除规范冗余、将原模型约化为有效n链伊辛模型），对2^n×2^n转移矩阵进行谱分解，推导出规范不变关联函数和任意宽度Wilson圈的通用公式。

papers.title: Non-adiabatic phonon renormalization in metallic versus insulating rutile oxides
papers.abstract: We present a comparative Raman scattering study of metallic rutile oxides (RuO$_2$ and IrO$_2$) and insulating rutiles (TiO$_2$ and SnO$_2$). Temperature-dependent Raman spectra reveal that the metallic compounds exhibit pronounced phonon frequency hardening, $ω(11~\mathrm{K})-ω(300~\mathrm{K})=Δω\approx 6$-$10~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$, whereas the insulating rutiles show only modest hardening, $Δω\approx 1$-$3~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$.
