Using first principles calculations, we show that coupled spin optical signals arise from interacting donor acceptor pairs, not the commonly believed isolated defects. Intra and inter pair separations control charge transfer, electronic structure, and spin coupling, thereby greatly modulating zero phonon lines, phonon sidebands, lifetimes, and the sign of optically detected magnetic resonance contrast. Importantly, we identify two distinct charge-state-dependent coupling regimes and extend this picture to correlated defect ensembles, explaining the wide diversity of experimental observations. Our results establish a microscopic framework for coupled defect behavior and provide design principles for spin-active quantum emitters in wide bandgap semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的可光学寻址自旋缺陷，具体为相互作用的施主-受主对（donor-acceptor pairs）及其产生的自旋-光学耦合信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 六方氮化硼中耦合的自旋-光学信号并非源于通常认为的孤立缺陷，而是来自相互作用的施主-受主对。施主-受主对内部及对间的距离控制着电荷转移、电子结构和自旋耦合，从而显著调制零声子线、声子边带、寿命以及光探测磁共振（ODMR）对比度的符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：六方氮化硼中耦合的自旋-光学信号并非源于通常认为的孤立缺陷，而是来自相互作用的施主-受主对。施主-受主对内部及对间的距离控制着电荷转移、电子结构和自旋耦合，从而显著调制零声子线、声子边带、寿命以及光探测磁共振（ODMR）对比度的符号。；创新点：首次提出并建立了相互作用施主-受主对作为hBN中耦合自旋-光学信号起源的微观框架，识别出两种依赖于电荷态的耦合机制，并将该图像推广至关联缺陷系综，从而解释了实验中观测到的广泛多样性。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），具体用于计算缺陷对的电子结构、自旋耦合、光学跃迁特性及ODMR信号。

papers.title: Pressure-induced superconductivity in epitaxially-stabilized Pr$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ films
papers.abstract: The discovery of high critical-temperature $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ under high pressure has led to a rapid expansion of the $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ range through lanthanide $Ln$ substitution, and to ambient-pressure superconductivity in strained thin films, yet the exploration of new bilayer nickelates remains strongly constrained by thermodynamic stability. Beyond the difficulty of synthesis of bulk single-crystals, here we report on the pressure-induced high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity in epitaxially-stabilized Pr$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ thin films. While the Pr$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ films exhibit insulating behaviour at ambient pressure regardless of ozone-annealing treatment, they show $T$-linear metallic transport and superconductivity reaching an onset $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ of 66 K and zero-resistance at nearly 40 K at 22 GPa. Furthermore, Nd$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, with the smaller rare-earth ion Nd, can also be stabilized, however, superconductivity is not observed in the measured pressure range. Epitaxial stabilization enables us to examine the dependence of $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ and the critical pressure $P_{\mathrm{c}}$ for superconductivity on the $Ln$ ion in $Ln_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ ($Ln$ = La, Pr, Nd). These results suggest that a higher $P_{\mathrm{c}}$ is required for smaller $Ln$ ions, consistent with trends observed in bulk studies of $Ln$ substitution. This study demonstrates that epitaxial stabilization is a powerful technique to further expand the family of superconducting bilayer nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report、thin films、transport、high pressure、epitaxial stabilization。；研究对象：外延稳定生长的Pr₃Ni₂O₇薄膜在高压下的超导电性，以及Ln₃Ni₂O₇（Ln = La, Pr, Nd）体系中稀土离子对超导转变温度和临界压力的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在22 GPa高压下，外延稳定的Pr₃Ni₂O₇薄膜表现出超导电性，起始超导转变温度达66 K，零电阻温度接近40 K；而同样外延稳定的Nd₃Ni₂O₇薄膜在测量压力范围内未观察到超导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在22 GPa高压下，外延稳定的Pr₃Ni₂O₇薄膜表现出超导电性，起始超导转变温度达66 K，零电阻温度接近40 K；而同样外延稳定的Nd₃Ni₂O₇薄膜在测量压力范围内未观察到超导。；创新点：通过外延稳定技术成功合成了块体单晶难以获得的Pr₃Ni₂O₇薄膜，并首次在该体系中观察到压力诱导的高温超导电性；同时系统比较了不同稀土离子（La、Pr、Nd）对超导临界压力和转变温度的影响，发现更小的稀土离子需要更高的临界压力，与块体研究趋势一致。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长薄膜、高压输运测量、臭氧退火处理。

papers.title: The Dislocation Content of Triple Junctions
papers.abstract: Triple junctions, line defects formed by the intersection of different grain boundaries, exist within all polycrystalline materials. While it has long been recognized that triple junctions could play an important role in microstructural evolution, there remains much uncertainty regarding their properties. Triple junctions are line defects capable of carrying dislocation content. However, no general method for calculating this content has been established. In this work, we derive the necessary equations to calculate the intrinsic dislocation content of a triple junction whose trichromatic pattern forms a coincidence site lattice. We further show that this approach can be easily applied to facet junctions, and in principle, any type of grain boundary junction for which a coincidence site lattice can be defined. We apply this formalism to atomistic simulations of tungsten to compute the Burgers vectors of a facet junction and a triple junction formed during twin grain nucleation and growth from a free surface. By tracking the evolution of the triple junction's Burgers vector and its core structure, we reveal the sequence of individual line defect reactions responsible for triple-junction-mediated twin growth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：推导了计算三叉晶界位错含量的方程，并应用于原子模拟（atomistic simulations）。；研究对象：多晶材料中的三叉晶界（triple junctions）及其位错含量，具体以钨（tungsten）中的小面结（facet junction）和孪晶生长过程中形成的三叉晶界为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出计算三叉晶界本征位错含量的通用方程，并通过原子模拟揭示了三叉晶界在孪晶生长过程中通过一系列线缺陷反应介导晶粒长大的具体机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出计算三叉晶界本征位错含量的通用方程，并通过原子模拟揭示了三叉晶界在孪晶生长过程中通过一系列线缺陷反应介导晶粒长大的具体机制。；创新点：建立了计算三叉晶界本征位错含量的一般性方法，并首次通过追踪伯氏矢量和核心结构演化，揭示了三叉晶界介导孪晶生长过程中单个线缺陷反应的具体序列。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（基于重合位置点阵/coincidence site lattice的三色图案/trichromatic pattern）结合原子模拟（atomistic simulations），计算了钨中三叉晶界的伯氏矢量（Burgers vectors）并追踪其核心结构演化。

papers.title: Distinct lattice and charge excitations in AV3Sb5 kagome superconductors
papers.abstract: The kagome superconductor family AV3Sb5 (A=Cs, Rb, K) provides a rich platform for exploring diverse electronic symmetry breaking phenomena, including superconductivity and various forms of density wave orders. Although these compounds share the identical lattice structure in the normal state, they exhibit distinct forms of symmetry breaking upon entering the charge density wave (CDW) phase, and the microscopic origin of which remain elusive. Here, we investigate the lattice and charge degrees of freedom in AV3Sb5 using angle-resolved polarized Raman spectroscopy. Our comprehensive polarization-resolved measurements reveal that the lifting of the twofold-degeneracy of the E2g phonon mode in the CDW phase-previously reported only in CsV3Sb5 with a 3 GHz splitting-also appears ubiquitously in the other two compounds. In contrast, the collective CDW excitations exhibit markedly different polarization dependences depending on the alkali-metal species. These distinct behaviors in the lattice and charge channels provide crucial insight into the enigmatic material-dependent symmetry breaking phenomena that appear in the CDW phase. Furthermore, our experiments, together with first-principles calculations and an effective Hamiltonian model, shed light on the nature of the charge order structure in AV3Sb5 kagome superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含理论计算辅助）。判断依据：angle-resolved polarized Raman spectroscopy（角分辨偏振拉曼光谱）、first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、effective Hamiltonian model（有效哈密顿模型）。；研究对象：AV₃Sb₅（A=Cs, Rb, K）笼目超导体家族中的晶格与电荷激发，特别是电荷密度波（CDW）相中对称性破缺的微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CDW相中，E₂g声子模式二重简并的解除（此前仅在CsV₃Sb₅中报道，分裂约3 GHz）在RbV₃Sb₅和KV₃Sb₅中也普遍存在；而集体CDW激发的偏振依赖特性则随碱金属种类显著不同，揭示了材料依赖的对称性破缺行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CDW相中，E₂g声子模式二重简并的解除（此前仅在CsV₃Sb₅中报道，分裂约3 GHz）在RbV₃Sb₅和KV₃Sb₅中也普遍存在；而集体CDW激发的偏振依赖特性则随碱金属种类显著不同，揭示了材料依赖的对称性破缺行为。；创新点：首次系统比较了三种AV₃Sb₅化合物在CDW相中晶格声子与电荷激发的偏振响应差异，揭示了晶格通道（声子简并解除）的普适性与电荷通道（CDW激发偏振依赖）的材料依赖性，为理解该体系中谜一般的材料依赖对称性破缺提供了关键实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨偏振拉曼光谱（angle-resolved polarized Raman spectroscopy）、第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）、有效哈密顿模型（effective Hamiltonian model）。

papers.title: Coexisting Ballistic and Diffusive Heat Transport in Micrometer-Long Molecular Junctions
papers.abstract: Boltzmann transport theory, the standard framework for predicting thermal conductivity, assumes that every vibrational mode eventually scatters, acquiring a finite lifetime that yields a convergent, length-independent thermal conductivity: Fourier's law. Here we show that this assumption fails in a real molecular system. Through atomistic simulations of Au-alkane-Au single-molecule junctions spanning five orders of magnitude in length (0.5 nm to 4 $μ$m), we find that thermal conductivity never converges. Transport is ballistic for up to one hundred nanometers at room temperature, extending nearly two orders of magnitude beyond existing single-molecule measurements. Past this window, conductivity diverges as $L^{1/3}$, the scaling predicted by the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class for momentum-conserving systems. Frequency-resolved decomposition of the heat current reveals the mechanism behind the divergence. Low-frequency acoustic modes never thermalize: protected by momentum conservation, they remain ballistic at every chain length, still carrying 50% of the total heat current at $L = 2 μ$m. All other modes thermalize collectively as discrete vibrational states merge into scattering-active phonon bands with increasing length. Hence, the diverging conductivity emerges from the boundary between these coexisting transport regimes: as $L$ grows, the onset of scattering shifts progressively toward lower frequencies, suppressing the ballistic channel at a rate that sustains the $L^{1/3}$ divergence, leaving a finite contribution at every length. This coexistence of permanent ballistic and well-behaved diffusive transport, anticipated in abstract one-dimensional lattice models, survives the structural and chemical complexity of real micrometer-sized junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：atomistic simulations、Boltzmann transport theory、Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class）；研究对象：金-烷烃-金单分子结（Au-alkane-Au single-molecule junctions），长度跨越0.5 nm至4 μm，研究其热输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在微米级分子结中，热导率永不收敛：室温下弹道输运可持续至百纳米尺度，之后热导率按L^{1/3}发散，源于低频率声学模式因动量守恒而永久保持弹道输运，与其余模式的扩散输运共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在微米级分子结中，热导率永不收敛：室温下弹道输运可持续至百纳米尺度，之后热导率按L^{1/3}发散，源于低频率声学模式因动量守恒而永久保持弹道输运，与其余模式的扩散输运共存。；创新点：首次在真实分子体系中（而非抽象一维晶格模型）证实了永久弹道输运与扩散输运的共存，并揭示其导致热导率随长度发散的具体机制（低频率声学模式永不热化）。
papers.method_zh: 原子尺度模拟（atomistic simulations），结合频率分辨的热流分解（frequency-resolved decomposition of heat current），并引用Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）普适类标度理论。

papers.title: Sub-10 mK "In-cell" Magnetic Refrigeration for Cryogen-free Cryostats
papers.abstract: A design and implementation of "in-cell" magnetic refrigeration to achieve sub-10 mK temperatures T in cryogen-free dilution refrigerators is presented. The ultra low temperatures below 5 mK are attained in finite magnetic fields B up to 1 T. The holding time below 5 mK varies between about 3 to 30 hours, depending on the final magnetic field after demagnetization process. The developed technique can be used to study low dimensional devices at ultra low electron temperatures in the High B/T regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：design and implementation（设计与实现）、attained（实现）、developed technique（开发的技术）。；研究对象：无液氦稀释制冷机中的“in-cell”磁制冷技术，用于实现亚10 mK的极低温环境。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过“in-cell”磁制冷设计，在无液氦稀释制冷机中成功实现了低于5 mK的极低温（在高达1 T的磁场下），且低于5 mK的保持时间约为3至30小时，具体取决于退磁后的最终磁场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过“in-cell”磁制冷设计，在无液氦稀释制冷机中成功实现了低于5 mK的极低温（在高达1 T的磁场下），且低于5 mK的保持时间约为3至30小时，具体取决于退磁后的最终磁场。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：磁制冷（magnetic refrigeration）技术，具体为“in-cell”设计，即在稀释制冷机内部集成磁制冷模块，通过退磁过程（demagnetization process）实现降温。

papers.title: Evaluating Blended Refrigerants for Thermochemical Energy Storage and Circular Refrigerant Recovery using Activated Carbons
papers.abstract: The climate crisis demands a rapid shift to sustainable energy technologies and higher efficiency in existing energy systems. Adsorption-based thermochemical energy storage is a promising alternative due to its high energy density and compatibility with renewable heat sources. In this work, we investigate the adsorption behavior of pure refrigerants (R32, R125, R134a, and R600) and their commercial blends (R410A, R407F, R417A, and R417C) in six activated carbons for thermochemical energy storage and circular refrigerant recovery. A multiscale computational workflow combining Monte Carlo simulations, thermodynamic modeling, and breakthrough simulations is developed to predict adsorption, storage, and separation behavior from pure-component adsorption data. The methodology integrates adsorption potential theory (APT), ideal adsorbed solution theory (IAST), and models for the isosteric heat of adsorption. In addition, an in-house computational framework is developed to calculate heats of adsorption and energy storage densities for both pure refrigerants and multicomponent mixtures. Although developed using molecular simulations as a benchmark, the methodology is directly applicable to experimental studies, since it only requires adsorption isotherms of the pure components as input to evaluate the performance of refrigerant blends. The results show that refrigerant blends can achieve higher storage densities than their pure counterparts due to cooperative adsorption and more efficient molecular packing. Furthermore, the activated carbons selectively separate key refrigerant components, highlighting their potential for sustainable refrigerant recovery. Overall, this work provides a general framework for the rational design and screening of next-generation refrigerant blends for adsorption-driven energy storage and separation applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte Carlo simulations, thermodynamic modeling, breakthrough simulations, molecular simulations）；研究对象：六种活性炭中纯制冷剂（R32、R125、R134a、R600）及其商业混合物（R410A、R407F、R417A、R417C）的吸附行为，用于热化学储能和制冷剂循环回收。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 制冷剂混合物由于协同吸附和更有效的分子堆积，能够实现比纯制冷剂更高的储能密度；活性炭可选择性地分离关键制冷剂组分，具有可持续制冷剂回收的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：制冷剂混合物由于协同吸附和更有效的分子堆积，能够实现比纯制冷剂更高的储能密度；活性炭可选择性地分离关键制冷剂组分，具有可持续制冷剂回收的潜力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 多尺度计算工作流，包括：蒙特卡洛模拟、热力学建模、穿透模拟；结合吸附势理论（APT）、理想吸附溶液理论（IAST）和等量吸附热模型；自建计算框架用于计算纯制冷剂和多组分混合物的吸附热及储能密度。

papers.title: Superconducting PdTe Thin Film Via Topotactic Transformation, Toward Topological Superconductors
papers.abstract: Topological superconductors (TSCs) hosting Majorana zero modes (MZMs) offer a pathway to fault-tolerant quantum computation. PdTe is a promising TSC candidate due to its topological surface states and a reasonable superconducting critical temperature of ~4.5 K. However, it has been challenging to grow PdTe thin films with bulk-like superconducting properties. Here, we show that high-quality, superconducting PdTe thin films can be grown using molecular beam epitaxy (MBE). The films exhibit a sharp superconducting transition (T_onset = 4.43 K with transition width of 0.06 K), comparable to that of bulk crystals. This was made possible via a topotactic transformation from a PdTe_2 buffer layer to a PdTe phase by growing Pd on top under Te-deficient conditions. Structural and transport analyses confirm the NiAs-type structure of PdTe, as well as its two-dimensional superconducting behavior and excellent air stability. These findings suggest that the MBE-grown PdTe films and their heterostructures are a promising platform for topological superconductivity and Majorana physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜的生长（分子束外延）、结构表征（结构分析）和输运测量（输运分析）。；研究对象：超导PdTe薄膜，以及其作为拓扑超导体候选材料的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子束外延（MBE）技术，利用拓扑转变方法成功生长出具有块材级超导性能的高质量PdTe薄膜，其超导转变温度（~4.43 K）和转变宽度（0.06 K）与块材相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子束外延（MBE）技术，利用拓扑转变方法成功生长出具有块材级超导性能的高质量PdTe薄膜，其超导转变温度（~4.43 K）和转变宽度（0.06 K）与块材相当。；创新点：通过从PdTe₂缓冲层到PdTe相的拓扑转变（在Te缺乏条件下在顶层生长Pd），成功克服了生长具有块材级超导性能的PdTe薄膜的挑战。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）薄膜生长技术；结构分析（确认NiAs型结构）；输运性质测量（确认二维超导行为）。

papers.title: Excitation-Energy-Selective Control of Hot-Carrier Cooling via a Resonant Optical-Phonon Bottleneck in Graphene
papers.abstract: Understanding and controlling hot-carrier relaxation in graphene is crucial for advancing ultrafast optoelectronic and terahertz technologies. Here, we investigate carrier cooling dynamics in monolayer and bilayer graphene using mid-infrared pump pulses (0.22-0.73 eV) and terahertz probe pulses. We uncover a pronounced, reproducible, and non-monotonic dependence of the carrier relaxation time on excitation photon energy. Remarkably, within a narrow spectral window (0.42 to 0.48 eV), the carrier lifetime increases by an order of magnitude compared to a few picosecond-scale cooling observed at other energies. We show that this anomalous slowdown originates from a resonant enhancement of the optical-phonon lifetime, causing accumulation and reabsorption of hot optical phonons that suppress energy transfer to the lattice. All observed behaviors are captured within a unified carrier-phonon energy-balance framework, where excitation-energy-dependent variations of the effective optical-phonon decay pathway govern the cooling dynamics. These findings demonstrate excitation-energy-selective control of hot-carrier relaxation in graphene and provide new insight into non-equilibrium carrier-phonon interactions near the optical-phonon bottleneck.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及使用“mid-infrared pump pulses”和“terahertz probe pulses”进行实验测量，并观察到了载流子弛豫时间的非单调依赖关系。；研究对象：单层和双层石墨烯中的热载流子冷却动力学，特别是光激发载流子与光学声子之间的非平衡相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在0.42至0.48 eV的窄激发光子能量窗口内，石墨烯中的载流子寿命比其它能量下观测到的皮秒级冷却时间增加了一个数量级。该异常减慢源于共振增强的光学声子寿命，导致热光学声子积累和再吸收，从而抑制了能量向晶格的传递。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在0.42至0.48 eV的窄激发光子能量窗口内，石墨烯中的载流子寿命比其它能量下观测到的皮秒级冷却时间增加了一个数量级。该异常减慢源于共振增强的光学声子寿命，导致热光学声子积累和再吸收，从而抑制了能量向晶格的传递。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用中红外泵浦脉冲（能量范围0.22-0.73 eV）激发载流子，并用太赫兹探测脉冲监测载流子冷却动力学。理论上，所有观测到的行为被一个统一的载流子-声子能量平衡框架所描述。

papers.title: Fröhlich-type Polarons in Isotopically Enriched Hexagonal Boron Nitride
papers.abstract: Exciton-phonon interactions play a central role in defining the optical response of hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), yet their quantitative determination has remained incomplete. Here, we reveal the Fröhlich-type exciton-phonon coupling in boron-10-enriched hBN using low-temperature cathodoluminescence. We resolve the indirect exciton 5.95$\pm$0.02 eV together with its longitudinal optical (LO) phonon replica detuned by 184$\pm$56 meV, enabling the extraction of a Fröhlich coupling constant $α$=0.159 and a larger exciton binding energy of 161 meV, larger than previously reported values for natural-abundance hBN, which is attributed to isotope enrichment. The inferred polaron radius exceeds the lattice constant, indicating large-polaron behavior. We deduced an exciton scattering time ~of 97 fs, corresponding to a homogeneous linewidth of ~6.76 meV. We further obtain a polaron binding energy of ~48 meV and an effective mass of 1.045 $m_0$. These results provide a direct quantitative characterization of exciton-phonon coupling in isotopically engineered hBN and establish a foundation for tailoring its phonon-polaritonic and quantum-optical properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：low-temperature cathodoluminescence（低温阴极发光）、extraction of coupling constant（提取耦合常数）、deduced scattering time（推导散射时间）。；研究对象：同位素富集六方氮化硼（boron-10-enriched hBN）中的Fröhlich型激子-声子耦合及极化子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在硼-10富集的六方氮化硼中，首次定量揭示了Fröhlich型激子-声子耦合，提取了Fröhlich耦合常数α=0.159，并发现同位素富集导致激子结合能（161 meV）大于天然丰度hBN的报道值，且极化子半径超过晶格常数，表现为大极化子行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在硼-10富集的六方氮化硼中，首次定量揭示了Fröhlich型激子-声子耦合，提取了Fröhlich耦合常数α=0.159，并发现同位素富集导致激子结合能（161 meV）大于天然丰度hBN的报道值，且极化子半径超过晶格常数，表现为大极化子行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 低温阴极发光（low-temperature cathodoluminescence）光谱技术，用于分辨间接激子及其纵光学（LO）声子复制峰，并结合理论模型提取耦合常数、结合能、散射时间、极化子结合能及有效质量等参数。

papers.title: An AI-driven robotic system for two-dimensional hetero-assemblies
papers.abstract: Nanomaterials stacked on-demand, such as rotationally assembled two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) layered compounds, provides a versatile platform for quantum simulation and the exploration of exotic electronic phases. Currently, however, such nanoassemblies remain largely confined to inefficiency, manually operated process, limiting their potential for probing emergent physical phenomena. There is a pressing need in the field for high-precision, automated assembling techniques, especially for the scalable fabrication of 2D twistronic heterostructures. Here, we present an intelligent automation system dedicated to the fabrication of van der Waals stacks, following the state-of-the-art protocol for dry transfer of exfoliated 2D materials. The system further employs metadata generated from each automated stacking procedure to perform reinforcement learning, thereby continuously bettering its performances. As a concrete demonstration, we fabricate twisted bilayer graphene (TBLG) -- known for its challenging preparation -- and exhibit its unconventional superconductivity near the magic angle. Our work may pave the way for high-throughput fabrication of low-dimensional nanomaterials including twistronic heterostructures, where integrating data mining and artificial intelligence can accelerate the discovery of novel physical phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：automated assembling techniques、dry transfer、reinforcement learning、fabricate twisted bilayer graphene。；研究对象：二维范德华异质结构，特别是扭转双层石墨烯（TBLG）及其非常规超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一套基于人工智能驱动的自动化机器人系统，能够高效、高精度地制备二维扭转异质结构，并成功制备出魔角附近的扭转双层石墨烯，观察到其非常规超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一套基于人工智能驱动的自动化机器人系统，能够高效、高精度地制备二维扭转异质结构，并成功制备出魔角附近的扭转双层石墨烯，观察到其非常规超导电性。；创新点：将人工智能（强化学习）与自动化机器人系统相结合，用于二维异质结构的可扩展、高精度制备，突破了传统手动操作的低效率瓶颈，有望实现高通量制造并加速新物理现象的发现。
papers.method_zh: 采用干法转移剥离的二维材料的标准实验流程，结合自动化机械操作与元数据驱动的强化学习算法，实现堆叠过程的自主优化与性能提升。

papers.title: Dataset-aware entropy-maximized active learning for machine-learned interatomic potentials
papers.abstract: We present an active learning framework for efficiently generating training data for machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). The method combines local entropy-driven molecular dynamics with global dataset-aware filtering: a per-configuration entropy term biases MD trajectories toward structurally diverse snapshots, while a global entropy measure, the log-determinant of the fingerprint covariance matrix of the entire dataset, selects only those configurations that provide genuinely new information. We employ dual covariance modes (per-atom for disordered structures and per-config for ordered phases) to achieve broad coverage of configuration space. Combined with a pre-trained foundation model (Allegro-OAM-L) and analytical fingerprint gradients from Gaussian overlap matrix eigenvalues, the framework produces high-quality domain-specific potentials with near- or sub-meV/atom accuracy on test data drawn from the same distribution at training-set sizes of order $10^{2}$ to $10^{3}$ entropy-selected DFT-labeled structures. We demonstrate the method on three systems spanning diverse bonding types and pressure-driven phase transitions: carbon (covalent), silicon (covalent/metallic), and NaCl (ionic). In learning curve comparisons against random molecular dynamics sampling at matched training set sizes ($N = 100$ to $800$), evaluated over three independent training-set draws per condition, entropy-driven sampling achieves a factor of approximately $3$ to $10$ lower energy MAE at $N = 800$ on in-distribution holdouts across the three systems, with the magnitude of the gain depending on the bonding type and the size at which the random-MD baseline saturates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“active learning framework”、“machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs)”、“molecular dynamics”、“DFT-labeled structures”。；研究对象：三种具有不同键合类型和压力驱动相变的材料体系：碳（共价键）、硅（共价/金属键）和NaCl（离子键）。研究聚焦于如何高效生成训练数据以构建机器学习原子间势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于数据集感知的熵最大化主动学习框架，在训练集大小仅为数百至数千个DFT标记结构时，即可生成精度接近或低于meV/atom的领域特定势函数；与随机分子动力学采样相比，在同等训练集大小（N=800）下，能量平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了约3至10倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于数据集感知的熵最大化主动学习框架，在训练集大小仅为数百至数千个DFT标记结构时，即可生成精度接近或低于meV/atom的领域特定势函数；与随机分子动力学采样相比，在同等训练集大小（N=800）下，能量平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了约3至10倍。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种主动学习框架，结合了局部熵驱动的分子动力学（用于生成结构多样化的轨迹快照）与全局数据集感知过滤（通过整个数据集指纹协方差矩阵的对数行列式选择真正提供新信息的构型）。采用双协方差模式（无序结构用逐原子模式，有序相用逐构型模式），并利用预训练基础模型（Allegro-OAM-L）和高斯重叠矩阵特征值的解析指纹梯度。

papers.title: Modeling phase separation in polymer-derived carbonitride ceramics through extended machine learning molecular dynamics
papers.abstract: Polymer-derived ceramics combine the thermal stability of ceramics with the versatile properties of carbon domains, but modeling their atomic-scale evolution during processing remains elusive due to the limitations of traditional computational methods. To address this issue, here we develop and apply a machine learning interatomic potential for silicon carbonitride-based (Si-C-N-H) systems, trained on a diversified database of over 9000 configurations -including amorphous models, high-temperature states, surfaces, and crystal structure predictions - to capture the full complexity of these materials. This potential enables large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of 8000-atom systems revealing the atomic-scale evolution of the polymer-derived ceramic during thermal treatment. A key result of this work is the occurrence of a phase separation where carbon domains progressively nucleate from the amorphous SiCN matrix during thermal processing, forming distinct graphene-like sheets while preserving the integrity of the ceramic network. The resulting models reproduce the experimental atomic pair distribution functions with exceptional fidelity, validating our approach and providing microscopic explanations for the material unique combination of ceramic and graphitic properties. In this process, defective 5- and/or 7-member carbon rings, mediate the transformation to stable 6-member aromatic structures. These findings offer new atomic-scale insights into the thermal stability and structural transformation pathways of polymer-derived ceramics, while our methodology opens avenues for studying complex amorphous systems with first-principles accuracy at experimentally relevant scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning molecular dynamics（机器学习分子动力学）、large-scale molecular dynamics simulations（大规模分子动力学模拟）、interatomic potential（原子间势）。；研究对象：聚合物衍生碳氮化硅陶瓷（Si-C-N-H体系）在热处理过程中的相分离与原子尺度结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在热处理过程中，非晶SiCN基体中会逐步成核并形成类石墨烯的碳域，同时保持陶瓷网络完整性；缺陷态的五元/七元碳环作为中间体，最终转变为稳定的六元芳香环结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在热处理过程中，非晶SiCN基体中会逐步成核并形成类石墨烯的碳域，同时保持陶瓷网络完整性；缺陷态的五元/七元碳环作为中间体，最终转变为稳定的六元芳香环结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于机器学习原子间势（ML-IAP）的大规模分子动力学模拟。训练数据库包含超过9000个构型（非晶模型、高温态、表面、晶体结构预测），模拟体系规模达8000原子。

papers.title: Velocity collapse and non-conformal spiral phase in the sawtooth spin chain
papers.abstract: Recent matrix-product-state calculations show that the spiral phase in the sawtooth chain has numerical signatures that are difficult to reconcile with an ordinary conformal critical point: a large apparent central charge, slow dynamical scaling, nearly flat excitations, and no detectable dimerization. We develop a bosonization theory for this phenomenology by embedding the sawtooth limit in a zigzag ladder described by two coupled SU(2)$_1$ conformal field theories characterized by an extreme velocity ratio. We show that the sawtooth geometry cancels the leading staggered interaction, leaving a marginal twist interaction that selectively collapses the slow apical spin velocity. Crucially, as this velocity vanishes, the generated apical backscattering interaction diverges only in dimensionless units, causing the energy scale to collapse independently of the spatial correlation length. This mechanism naturally accounts for many of the numerical anomalies and we interpret the perturbative flow as an entrance to local quantum criticality in the strong-coupling regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：bosonization theory、conformal field theories、perturbative flow。；研究对象：锯齿链（sawtooth chain）中的螺旋相（spiral phase），以及该相中出现的非共形临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 锯齿链的几何结构抵消了主导的交错相互作用，留下边缘扭曲相互作用，导致慢支自旋速度选择性坍缩；当速度消失时，产生的背散射相互作用仅在无量纲单位下发散，使得能量尺度独立于空间关联长度而坍缩，从而解释了数值计算中观察到的异常现象，并指向强耦合区域中的局域量子临界性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：锯齿链的几何结构抵消了主导的交错相互作用，留下边缘扭曲相互作用，导致慢支自旋速度选择性坍缩；当速度消失时，产生的背散射相互作用仅在无量纲单位下发散，使得能量尺度独立于空间关联长度而坍缩，从而解释了数值计算中观察到的异常现象，并指向强耦合区域中的局域量子临界性。；创新点：揭示了锯齿链中速度坍缩（velocity collapse）与非共形螺旋相之间的内在机制，指出能量尺度与空间关联长度的解耦是导致数值异常（如大表观中心荷、慢动力学标度、近乎平坦的激发）的根本原因，并将微扰流解释为进入强耦合局域量子临界性的入口。
papers.method_zh: 通过将锯齿链嵌入由两个耦合的SU(2)₁共形场论描述的锯齿形梯子（zigzag ladder）中，构建玻色化理论，并分析极端速度比下的重整化群流。

papers.title: Textured phase diagrams of featureless insulators
papers.abstract: We study phase diagrams of charge-conserving `class A' non-interacting fermions, focusing on the trivial phase in various dimensions. Such phases are usually termed `featureless' to distinguish them from those others with either symmetry-broken or topological order. We show that the presence of non-trivial topological families of states, including charge pumps and their generalizations, results in phase diagrams being endowed with non-trivial topological textures that can be visualized through Berry phases and their higher-dimensional generalizations. We show that for non-interacting fermion systems with translation invariance, these `higher' Berry phases can be computed using integrals of non-abelian Chern-Simons forms of the Berry-Bloch connection over momentum and parameter spaces. Singularities in these textures correspond to gap-closing loci of `diabolical points', which represent the obstruction to contracting topologically non-trivial families of states, and bulk-boundary correspondence results in a locus of robust boundary modes that terminate at the bulk diabolical points. In the presence of finite chemical potential, we argue that the edge modes are generically robust without any need for fine-tuning for two and higher dimensions, whereas in one dimension they are `estranged' in the phase diagram, i.e. appearing at different parameter values for different edges. We demonstrate our results by constructing several microscopic models of non-interacting fermions. We argue stability to interactions and explore proximate phase diagrams by mapping to continuum field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、show、argue、constructing models、mapping to continuum field theories。；研究对象：电荷守恒的“A类”无相互作用费米子体系中的“无特征”绝缘体相图，重点关注其拓扑纹理结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无特征绝缘体的相图并非平凡，而是具有非平凡的拓扑纹理，这些纹理可通过Berry相位及其高维推广来可视化；纹理中的奇点对应能隙闭合的“魔鬼点”，并导致鲁棒的边界模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无特征绝缘体的相图并非平凡，而是具有非平凡的拓扑纹理，这些纹理可通过Berry相位及其高维推广来可视化；纹理中的奇点对应能隙闭合的“魔鬼点”，并导致鲁棒的边界模。；创新点：揭示了通常被认为是“无特征”的绝缘体相图实际上具有非平凡的拓扑纹理结构，并建立了这些纹理与电荷泵、魔鬼点及边界模之间的系统联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用动量空间和参数空间上的非阿贝尔Chern-Simons形式计算“高阶”Berry相位；构建多个无相互作用费米子的微观模型进行演示；通过映射到连续场论探讨近邻相图及相互作用稳定性。

papers.title: Targeting Clause Type Distributions: a Picklock for Random Satisfiability Problems
papers.abstract: Optimization problems such as the NP-complete 3-SAT provide an important benchmark for the difficult task of finding ground-states in strongly correlated many-body systems with rugged energy landscapes. The study of random 3-SAT problems as Ising spin Hamiltonians in statistical physics has yielded major insights including the existence of a satisfiability phase transition, and the prediction of a critical parameter line of particularly hard instances. Yet, progress on solving those instances has been scarce for several decades. Here, introducing the Target-SAT (TSAT) algorithm, we roughly triple the tractable problem sizes in the hardest regime, with an even greater improvement in a vast range of neighboring regions. By leveraging statistical information hidden in the combinatorial constraints of the problem, TSAT is actively guided in its stochastic local search toward a target within the relevant parameter space. Our analysis also explains why established local search algorithms are limited to relatively small system sizes due to a vast low-energy trap. Furthermore, we characterize the aforementioned critical line in terms of a dominant additional complexity barrier, whose exponential scaling is quickly overcome by TSAT only in the surrounding parameter space. With TSAT, the lead in solving the hardest known random satisfiability problems returns to the realm of stochastic local search algorithms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提到了“引入Target-SAT (TSAT)算法”、“随机局部搜索”、“分析”等关键词，属于算法设计与理论分析。；研究对象：随机3-SAT问题（NP完全问题）的求解，该问题被类比为具有崎岖能量景观的强关联多体系统的基态寻找问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过利用问题组合约束中隐藏的统计信息，新提出的TSAT算法在随机3-SAT问题的最难参数区域，将可处理的问题规模提升了约三倍，并在邻近区域实现了更大的改进。同时，研究揭示了传统局部搜索算法因存在巨大的低能陷阱而受限于较小系统尺寸的原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过利用问题组合约束中隐藏的统计信息，新提出的TSAT算法在随机3-SAT问题的最难参数区域，将可处理的问题规模提升了约三倍，并在邻近区域实现了更大的改进。同时，研究揭示了传统局部搜索算法因存在巨大的低能陷阱而受限于较小系统尺寸的原因。；创新点：将随机3-SAT问题的求解领先地位重新带回随机局部搜索算法领域，并首次在统计物理预测的临界参数线上，识别出一个主导性的额外复杂性障碍，并展示了TSAT算法如何在其周围的参数空间中克服该障碍的指数级标度。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个名为Target-SAT (TSAT)的随机局部搜索算法。该算法通过利用问题组合约束中的统计信息，主动引导搜索过程朝向参数空间中的某个目标进行。

papers.title: Representability-Aware Neural Networks for Reduced Density Matrices: Application to Fractional Chern Insulators
papers.abstract: We develop a representability-aware and interpolable neural network (NN) framework for predicting two-particle reduced density matrices (2-RDMs). The NN incorporates a subset of representability conditions through its architecture and loss function, and can operate on different momentum meshes, enabling evaluating the representability conditions across multiple meshes, which we call interpolated representability condition. The framework can be used either to predict 2-RDMs on large momentum meshes by interpolating exact results from small meshes, or as a variational 2-RDM ansatz optimized by energy minimization on arbitrary meshes. We apply this approach to the fractional Chern insulator in the one-band projected model of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ at twist angle $3.89^\circ$ and hole filling $2/3$. Trained on exact-diagonalization (ED) 2-RDMs from meshes with $12$ or $18$ momentum points using six different NN architectures, the best NN is the residual multilayer perceptron, which predicts the $6\times6$ 2-RDM with $97.07\%-98.18\%$ accuracy relative to the ED 2-RDM but predicts an energy $77.353$ meV above ED ground-state energy. We then variationally optimize the NN on several meshes including $6\times6$, predicting a $6\times 6$ energy of just $0.104$ meV below ED while maintaining $98.94\%-98.96\%$ accuracy. Compared with the conventional boundary-point semidefinite programming, which gives an energy $5.560$ meV below ED with $96.40\%-98.94\%$ accuracy, the NN achieves a more accurate energy and similar accuracy while using only less than 1/20 as many parameters. Eventually, we add a symmetric mesh of $48$ momentum points to the variational optimization of the NN, and provide a prediction of the many-body ground-state energy and the many-body quantum metric on that mesh.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：neural network framework、exact-diagonalization、variational optimization。；研究对象：分数陈绝缘体（Fractional Chern Insulator），具体为转角双层MoTe₂在扭转角3.89°和空穴填充2/3条件下的单带投影模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发的可表示性感知神经网络框架能够以极高精度预测双粒子约化密度矩阵（2-RDM），在6×6动量网格上变分优化得到的能量仅比精确对角化结果低0.104 meV，且精度优于传统边界点半定规划方法，参数数量仅为后者的1/20以下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发的可表示性感知神经网络框架能够以极高精度预测双粒子约化密度矩阵（2-RDM），在6×6动量网格上变分优化得到的能量仅比精确对角化结果低0.104 meV，且精度优于传统边界点半定规划方法，参数数量仅为后者的1/20以下。；创新点：将可表示性条件直接嵌入神经网络架构和损失函数，并实现跨不同动量网格的插值可表示性条件评估，使网络既能从小网格插值预测大网格2-RDM，又能作为变分2-RDM拟设进行能量最小化优化。
papers.method_zh: 构建可表示性感知且可插值的神经网络框架，通过网络架构和损失函数融入部分可表示性条件，并引入跨动量网格的插值可表示性条件。采用残差多层感知机等六种网络架构，在12或18个动量点的网格上使用精确对角化得到的2-RDM进行训练，并在6×6及48个动量点的网格上进行变分优化。

papers.title: A Design Framework for Compositional Hierarchical Mechanical Metamaterials via a Qualitative Unit-Cell Library
papers.abstract: Hierarchically designed mechanical metamaterials involve nested levels of structural organization, mimicking natural structures (such as bones, wood, and bird feathers) to create advanced functional materials. Compositional hierarchy, a specific type of hierarchical strategy that involves the methodical assembly of discrete building blocks, offers unique advantages in engineering design due to its modular nature. This involves proper selection and spatial arrangements of distinct microstructures, as a result of which the desired macro-scale mechanical behavior can be achieved. Towards the design of such compositional hierarchical metamaterials, this paper presents a two-step design framework. First, material optimization of the design domain is performed using a parameterized elasticity matrix to obtain optimal conceptual designs. Second, building-block microstructure geometries are selected from a qualitative library and subjected to shape-size refinement to satisfy the desired kinematic or stiffness requirements. To construct the qualitative library, a novel parametrization scheme is initially introduced, which categorizes the planar orthotropic elasticity matrix into four distinct classes. Utilizing a kinetostatic load flow visualization technique, the candidate microstructure geometries are then populated within these four classes. The framework is validated for the design of a cantilever beam with a specified lateral stiffness requirement and the design of planar sheets that exhibit specified target deformation patterns. Thus, the present work provides a systematic and physically intuitive methodology applicable to arbitrary kinematic deformation and stiffness requirements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：设计框架、参数化、优化、可视化技术。；研究对象：层级结构力学超材料（compositional hierarchical mechanical metamaterials），特别是通过离散构建块（building blocks）的模块化组装实现特定宏观力学行为的设计方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种两步设计框架：先通过参数化弹性矩阵进行材料优化获得概念设计，再从定性单元库中选取微结构几何形状并进行形状-尺寸精炼，以满足指定的运动学或刚度要求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种两步设计框架：先通过参数化弹性矩阵进行材料优化获得概念设计，再从定性单元库中选取微结构几何形状并进行形状-尺寸精炼，以满足指定的运动学或刚度要求。；创新点：提出了一种结合定性单元库与参数化弹性矩阵的系统性、物理直观的设计框架，适用于任意运动学变形和刚度要求，并首次将平面正交各向异性弹性矩阵分类与微结构几何形状库构建相结合。
papers.method_zh: 采用参数化弹性矩阵进行材料优化；引入一种新的参数化方案将平面正交各向异性弹性矩阵分为四类；利用运动静力学载荷流可视化技术（kinetostatic load flow visualization technique）填充候选微结构几何形状；通过悬臂梁和平面薄板的变形与刚度设计进行验证。

papers.title: Quantifying Hyperparameter Transfer and the Importance of Embedding Layer Learning Rate
papers.abstract: Hyperparameter transfer allows extrapolating optimal optimization hyperparameters from small to large scales, making it critical for training large language models (LLMs). This is done either by fitting a scaling law to the hyperparameters or by a judicious choice of parameterization, such as Maximal Update ($μ$P), that renders optimal hyperparameters approximately scale invariant. In this paper, we first develop a framework to quantify hyperparameter transfer through three metrics: (1) the quality of the scaling law fit, (2) the robustness to extrapolation errors, and (3) the asymptotic loss penalty due to choice of parameterization. Next, we investigate through a comprehensive series of ablations why $μ$P appears to offer high-quality learning rate transfer relative to standard parameterization (SP), as existing theory is inadequate. We find that the overwhelming benefit of $μ$P relative to SP when training with AdamW arises simply from maximizing the learning rate of the embedding layer. In SP, the embedding layer learning rate acts as a bottleneck that induces training instabilities; increasing it by a factor of width to match $μ$P dramatically smooths out training while improving hyperparameter transfer. We also find that weight decay improves the scaling law fits, while, in the fixed token-per-parameter setting, it hurts the robustness of the extrapolation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：hyperparameter transfer、scaling law、parameterization、ablation study。；研究对象：大型语言模型（LLMs）训练中的超参数迁移问题，具体聚焦于嵌入层学习率对训练稳定性和超参数迁移质量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: μP（Maximal Update）参数化相对于标准参数化（SP）在AdamW训练中带来的超参数迁移优势，主要源于其允许嵌入层学习率随宽度增大而增大，从而消除训练不稳定性；此外，权重衰减可改善标度律拟合质量，但在固定token-per-parameter设置下会损害外推鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：μP（Maximal Update）参数化相对于标准参数化（SP）在AdamW训练中带来的超参数迁移优势，主要源于其允许嵌入层学习率随宽度增大而增大，从而消除训练不稳定性；此外，权重衰减可改善标度律拟合质量，但在固定token-per-parameter设置下会损害外推鲁棒性。；创新点：揭示了μP相对于SP在超参数迁移中的核心机制并非现有理论所描述的完整参数化优势，而是源于嵌入层学习率的放大效应；同时首次量化了权重衰减在固定token-per-parameter条件下对外推鲁棒性的负面影响。
papers.method_zh: 通过三个量化指标（标度律拟合质量、外推误差鲁棒性、参数化选择导致的渐近损失惩罚）构建超参数迁移评估框架，并基于AdamW优化器进行系统性消融实验（ablation study），对比μP与SP参数化下嵌入层学习率的影响。

papers.title: Approximation Theory for Neural Networks: Old and New
papers.abstract: Universal approximation theorems provide a mathematical explanation for the expressive power of neural networks. They assert that, under mild conditions on the activation function, feedforward neural networks are dense in broad function classes, such as continuous functions on compact subsets of $\mathbb{R}^d$, $L^p$ spaces, or Sobolev spaces. Over the past four decades, these qualitative universality results have evolved into a rich quantitative theory addressing approximation rates, parameter efficiency, and the role of architectural features such as depth and width. This survey presents several glimpses into this theory. We review classical density results for single-hidden-layer networks, as well as quantitative bounds that relate approximation error to network size and smoothness assumptions on target functions. Particular emphasis is placed on depth--width trade-offs and on results demonstrating that deeper architectures can achieve superior parameter efficiency for structured function classes. In addition to standard feedforward neural networks, we also review recent developments on Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs), which offer an alternative architectural paradigm and whose approximation-theoretic properties have begun to attract significant theoretical attention.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：综述、近似理论、数学解释、定量理论）；研究对象：神经网络（包括标准前馈神经网络和Kolmogorov-Arnold网络）的数学近似能力，而非具体的凝聚态物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该综述总结了神经网络通用近似定理从定性结果到定量理论（如近似速率、参数效率、深度-宽度权衡）的发展历程，并指出更深层的架构在特定函数类上具有更优的参数效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该综述总结了神经网络通用近似定理从定性结果到定量理论（如近似速率、参数效率、深度-宽度权衡）的发展历程，并指出更深层的架构在特定函数类上具有更优的参数效率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该综述相对于已有综述的具体创新点，但其特色在于：1）系统性地梳理了从经典定性结果到现代定量理论的演进；2）特别强调了深度-宽度权衡这一核心问题；3）将最新的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）纳入近似理论的讨论框架。
papers.method_zh: 数学分析与理论推导，具体包括：回顾单隐层网络的密度结果、建立近似误差与网络大小及目标函数光滑性之间的定量界、分析深度-宽度权衡，并介绍Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）的近似理论特性。

papers.title: Memorisation, convergence and generalisation in generative models
papers.abstract: Generative neural networks learn how to produce highly realistic images from a large, but finite number of examples - or do they simply memorise their training set? To settle this question, Kadkhodaie, Guth, Simoncelli and Mallat (ICLR '24) trained diffusion models independently on disjoint subsets of a dataset and showed that they converge to nearly the same density when the number of training images is large enough. This result raises two basic questions: how much data do you need for convergence, and what does convergence capture about learning the data distribution? Here, we address these questions by providing an exact analytical characterisation of the transition from memorisation to generalisation in linear generative models. We find that these models memorise at small load, while convergence emerges continuously when the number of samples is linear in the input dimension. Strikingly, we find that convergence is insensitive to recovery of the principal latent factors of the data, which are recovered in a sharp transition. After extending our approach to data with power-law spectra, we find the same distinction between convergence and latent recovery in our experiments with convolutional denoisers and in the data of Kadkhodaie et al. We thus show that generalisation in generative models decomposes into at least two distinct objectives: matching the bulk of the data distribution and recovering the principal latent factors. These objectives correspond to two different distances between true and learnt data distribution, and only the first one is captured by convergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical characterisation、linear generative models、theoretical framework）；研究对象：生成模型中的记忆、收敛与泛化行为，具体以线性生成模型为研究对象，并扩展到卷积去噪器及扩散模型数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生成模型的泛化可分解为至少两个不同目标：匹配数据分布的主体（由收敛性刻画）和恢复数据的主要潜在因子（在尖锐相变中恢复），两者对应不同的真实与学习分布之间的距离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生成模型的泛化可分解为至少两个不同目标：匹配数据分布的主体（由收敛性刻画）和恢复数据的主要潜在因子（在尖锐相变中恢复），两者对应不同的真实与学习分布之间的距离。；创新点：首次精确刻画了线性生成模型中从记忆到泛化的转变，并揭示收敛性与潜在因子恢复之间的本质区别——收敛对数据主成分的恢复不敏感，后者在尖锐相变中才实现。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（exact analytical characterisation），对线性生成模型进行精确理论刻画；结合数值实验（convolutional denoisers）及对Kadkhodaie等人扩散模型数据的再分析。

papers.title: Micro-explosion of emulsion droplets with nanoparticles at high temperature
papers.abstract: Compared with traditional fuels, emulsified fuels can improve fuel atomization and combustion, and nanoparticles as additives have the potential to enhance combustion and reduce emissions. Previous studies on micro-explosion mainly considered emulsion droplets, but the role of nanoparticles in emulsion droplets is still unclear. In this study, we experimentally investigate the micro-explosion of emulsion droplets with nanoparticles via high-speed photography, digital image processing, optical microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy. The results show that the presence of nanoparticles can greatly improve the strength and probability of micro-explosion, particularly for carbon nanoparticles. This is mainly because nanoparticles can agglomerate during the evaporation of emulsion droplets, facilitate the absorption of radiation energy, inhibit the diffusion of superheated vapor, and ultimately promote micro-explosion. The effects of nanoparticle mass fraction and water content are also investigated, and the results show that the increase of nanoparticles and water can facilitate micro-explosion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimentally investigate、high-speed photography、digital image processing、optical microscopy、scanning electron microscopy。；研究对象：高温下含有纳米颗粒的乳化液滴的微爆现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米颗粒（尤其是碳纳米颗粒）的存在能显著增强乳化液滴微爆的强度和概率，主要机制包括促进辐射能量吸收、抑制过热蒸汽扩散以及纳米颗粒团聚效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米颗粒（尤其是碳纳米颗粒）的存在能显著增强乳化液滴微爆的强度和概率，主要机制包括促进辐射能量吸收、抑制过热蒸汽扩散以及纳米颗粒团聚效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高速摄影、数字图像处理、光学显微镜、扫描电子显微镜。

papers.title: Universal fusion category symmetries on tensor products of infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces
papers.abstract: We show that anyon chains, after stabilizing with infinite-dimensional ancilla spaces, factorize locally as tensor products of infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. This implies that any unitary fusion category can be realized as symmetries on a tensor product of infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. We then show that any two anyon chains with the same symmetry category are related by a symmetry-compatible locality-preserving unitary after stabilizing with infinite-dimensional ancilla, showing that for a fixed fusion category, there is a single stable equivalence class of symmetry realizations on the lattice via anyon chains. As a corollary of our proof, we show that the physical boundary algebras of Levin-Wen type models are bounded spread isomorphic after stabilization if and only if they have the same bulk topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”、“our proof”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：任意子链（anyon chains）在无限维希尔伯特空间张量积上的对称性实现，以及Levin-Wen型模型的边界代数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任意子链在通过无限维辅助空间稳定化后，可以局域地分解为无限维希尔伯特空间的张量积，从而证明任何幺正融合范畴都可以作为这种张量积空间上的对称性实现。此外，具有相同对称范畴的任意子链在稳定化后可以通过对称性兼容的局域性保持幺正变换相互关联，即存在单一的稳定等价类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任意子链在通过无限维辅助空间稳定化后，可以局域地分解为无限维希尔伯特空间的张量积，从而证明任何幺正融合范畴都可以作为这种张量积空间上的对称性实现。此外，具有相同对称范畴的任意子链在稳定化后可以通过对称性兼容的局域性保持幺正变换相互关联，即存在单一的稳定等价类。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，包括任意子链的稳定化构造、融合范畴对称性的代数实现、以及Levin-Wen型模型边界代数的有界展形同构（bounded spread isomorphism）分析。

papers.title: Matching $A$ with $F$ in long-range QFTs
papers.abstract: Irreversibility theorems -- such as the $A$-theorem -- establish a hierarchy among fixed points of the renormalization group flow. The strongest thesis of this type of theorems would be that there exists a scalar function $A$ (generally suggested by the topological Weyl anomaly) and a positive definite metric $G_{IJ}$ in the space of couplings such that the renormalization group flow satisfies a gradient equation, $\partial_I A= G_{IJ}β^J$, in which case $A$ is locally monotonic along the flow. In this paper we consider the long-range multiscalar $φ^4$ theory, a theory without a local energy-momentum tensor that is unitary in $d=2,3$ and that is believed to be conformally invariant at fixed points, and show that its renormalization group flow satisfies the gradient structure up to the third loop order in the coupling. We also show that $A$ and $G_{IJ}$ can be matched to the leading nontrivial order with the sphere free-energy $\tilde{F}$ and Zamolodchikov's metric $C_{IJ}$ of the corresponding conformal theory concentrating on the examples of the long-range vector $O(N)$ and hypercubic $H_N$ models. Our results imply a perturbative proof of the $\tilde{F}$-theorem at the leading nontrivial order. We conclude the paper discussing briefly whether this result should hold to the next orders in perturbation theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：gradient equation、renormalization group flow、perturbative proof。；研究对象：长程多标量φ⁴理论（long-range multiscalar φ⁴ theory），特别是长程矢量O(N)模型和超立方H_N模型，这些理论在d=2,3维中具有幺正性且固定点处具有共形不变性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了长程多标量φ⁴理论的重整化群流在耦合常数三圈阶满足梯度结构（∂_I A = G_{IJ} β^J），并且A和G_{IJ}在领头非平凡阶可与对应共形理论的球面自由能F̃和Zamolodchikov度量C_{IJ}匹配，从而在微扰论领头非平凡阶证明了F̃-定理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了长程多标量φ⁴理论的重整化群流在耦合常数三圈阶满足梯度结构（∂_I A = G_{IJ} β^J），并且A和G_{IJ}在领头非平凡阶可与对应共形理论的球面自由能F̃和Zamolodchikov度量C_{IJ}匹配，从而在微扰论领头非平凡阶证明了F̃-定理。；创新点：首次在缺乏局域能量-动量张量的长程量子场论中（如长程φ⁴理论）验证了重整化群流的梯度结构，并建立了A函数与球面自由能F̃之间的对应关系，为F̃-定理提供了微扰论领头阶的证明。
papers.method_zh: 采用微扰论方法，在耦合常数空间中进行多圈阶计算，通过分析重整化群流方程验证梯度结构的存在性，并利用球面自由能和Zamolodchikov度量进行匹配。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of homogeneous Universes: de Sitter, Bonnor-Melvin and static Einstein
papers.abstract: In the theories, in which dynamic gravitational field emerges from the underlying matter fields, the gravitational field can be considered as a part of matter. Using this approach, we construct the thermodynamics of the homogeneous Universes -- the de Sitter Universe, the Bonnor-Melvin-$Λ$ Universe and the static Einstein Universe. It is demonstrated that although these three Universes have different types of matter fields (ordinary matter, magnetic field, gravitational field and vacuum energy), they have the same thermodynamic properties. Their energy densities obey the same equation, which contains the corresponding matter densities and the pairs of the thermodynamically conjugate variables. In Minkowski vacuum, where the ordinary matter and magnetic and gravitational fields are absent, this thermodynamic approach automatically leads to zero cosmological constant.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamics、emerge、theories、approach。；研究对象：三种均匀宇宙模型的热力学性质：de Sitter宇宙、Bonnor-Melvin-Λ宇宙和静态Einstein宇宙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管这三种宇宙包含不同类型的物质场（普通物质、磁场、引力场和真空能），但它们具有相同的热力学性质，其能量密度遵循相同的方程。在Minkowski真空中，该热力学方法自动导致宇宙学常数为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管这三种宇宙包含不同类型的物质场（普通物质、磁场、引力场和真空能），但它们具有相同的热力学性质，其能量密度遵循相同的方程。在Minkowski真空中，该热力学方法自动导致宇宙学常数为零。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于引力场从底层物质场涌现的理论框架，将引力场视为物质的一部分，构建均匀宇宙的热力学。

papers.title: Towards transistor-based quantum computing
papers.abstract: In this work, we propose and study in depth a universal quantum computing architecture based on a quantum construction of transistors. Our teleportation-based quantum transistors, called ``telesistors'', are ground states of systems with symmetry-protected topological order, hence suppress certain noises and provide high-fidelity Clifford gates without the need for active error correction. This physical protection, quantified by the string order parameters, serves as a low-overhead foundation upon which conventional fault-tolerant encoding (e.g., with stabilizer codes) can be built to achieve universal quantum computation. This architecture shows rich connections with current known architectures, and some desirable merits especially compared with the qubit-based circuits regarding modularity, integration, and program storage. Our study shows that it is plausible to realize it with current technology in the near future.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、study、architecture、quantum construction of transistors、ground states、symmetry-protected topological order。；研究对象：基于量子晶体管（称为“telesistors”）的通用量子计算架构，其物理基础是具有对称性保护拓扑序（SPT）的系统的基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于“telesistors”的通用量子计算架构，该架构利用对称性保护拓扑序提供的物理保护，无需主动纠错即可实现高保真度的Clifford门，并可作为低开销基础构建容错编码以实现通用量子计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于“telesistors”的通用量子计算架构，该架构利用对称性保护拓扑序提供的物理保护，无需主动纠错即可实现高保真度的Clifford门，并可作为低开销基础构建容错编码以实现通用量子计算。；创新点：提出了一种将量子晶体管（telesistors）与对称性保护拓扑序相结合的模块化、可集成、可存储程序的量子计算架构，相比传统基于量子比特的电路在模块化、集成度和程序存储方面具有优势，且有望在近期现有技术下实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于量子隐形传态的量子晶体管（telesistors）设计，利用对称性保护拓扑序（SPT）的基态特性，通过弦序参量（string order parameters）量化物理保护，并讨论与稳定子码等容错编码的结合。

papers.title: A Universal Magnetoelectric Limit for Chiral and Tellegen Bi-Isotropic Scatterers
papers.abstract: We reveal the existence of a universal upper bound on the magnetoelectric coupling of any bi-isotropic nanoparticle. The bound arises solely from energy conservation, making it independent of the specific material properties of the nanoparticle and illumination conditions. Moreover, the bound does not rely on reciprocity, being identical for reciprocal (chiral) and non-reciprocal (Tellegen) nanoparticles. We further show that the chiral Mie coefficient of spherical particles of arbitrary optical size obeys the same bound across all multipolar scattering channels. Our results introduce a universal metric on the magnetoelectric coupling of bi-isotropic objects, setting identical limits on chiral and Tellegen light-matter interactions at the single particle level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“reveal the existence of a universal upper bound”、“arises solely from energy conservation”、“theoretical framework”。；研究对象：双各向同性纳米颗粒（bi-isotropic nanoparticles）中的磁电耦合效应，具体包括手性（chiral）和特勒根（Tellegen）两种类型的散射体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现任何双各向同性纳米颗粒的磁电耦合存在一个普适上限，该上限仅由能量守恒决定，与材料特性和光照条件无关，且对手性和非互易（特勒根）颗粒完全相同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现任何双各向同性纳米颗粒的磁电耦合存在一个普适上限，该上限仅由能量守恒决定，与材料特性和光照条件无关，且对手性和非互易（特勒根）颗粒完全相同。；创新点：首次提出双各向同性物体磁电耦合的普适度量标准，并证明该上限对互易（手性）和非互易（特勒根）颗粒具有相同的约束力，突破了以往对材料特性和互易性的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量守恒原理推导出磁电耦合的普适上限，并进一步通过分析球形颗粒的米氏系数（Mie coefficient）验证该上限在所有多极散射通道中均成立。

papers.title: Equilibrium and dynamics of a three-state opinion model on a network of networks
papers.abstract: Opinion formation models typically represent each individual as a single variable. However, in practice each individual holds interconnected beliefs whose internal organization may influence collective outcomes. To explore this dependence, we study a three-state opinion model on a network of networks in which each agent has an internal belief graph and interacts with other agents through an external social graph. Each belief can take two opposite polarized states or a neutral one and a neutrality parameter tunes the relative conviction of the neutral stance. We incorporate temperature into the model to account for external social agitation and for the tolerance of internal cognitive dissonance. We explore the stationary state and dynamics of the model using analytical approaches and Monte Carlo simulations on a fully connected external social graph, with internal belief topologies given by one-dimensional chains, cliques, and star-like structures, where there is a central core belief to which all other beliefs are connected. We find that the critical temperature at which the polarized consensus destabilizes increases with the addition of more beliefs to star-like agents but saturates in the case of ring- and clique-like internal topologies. We also consider binary mixtures of agents with different internal topologies in equal proportions, showing that the interplay between agents is regime-dependent, with the dominant topology depending on the value of the neutrality parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical approaches, Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：基于网络之网络（network of networks）的三态意见模型，每个智能体具有内部信念图结构，并通过外部社交图与其他智能体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 极化共识失稳的临界温度随星型内部拓扑中信念数量的增加而升高，但在环型和团型内部拓扑中趋于饱和；不同内部拓扑的智能体混合时，主导拓扑取决于中性参数的值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：极化共识失稳的临界温度随星型内部拓扑中信念数量的增加而升高，但在环型和团型内部拓扑中趋于饱和；不同内部拓扑的智能体混合时，主导拓扑取决于中性参数的值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析方法（analytical approaches）与蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations），外部社交图采用全连接结构，内部信念拓扑分别采用一维链、团和星型结构。

papers.title: Symmetry-Protected Fast Relaxation and the Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect
papers.abstract: Understanding how symmetry constrains dissipative relaxation in open quantum many-body systems remains a central challenge in nonequilibrium physics. Here we uncover a symmetry-selective Liouvillian mechanism that protects an isolated fast-decay channel in a long-range XXZ spin chain subject to dephasing noise. At the \(SU(2)\)-symmetric point, highly symmetric initial states couple exclusively to an exact Liouvillian eigenmode with decay rate \(λ=-2\), producing universal exponential relaxation independent of system size and interaction range. Breaking the symmetry restores overlap with slow Liouvillian modes and substantially suppresses the relaxation dynamics. This symmetry-filtered mode accessibility naturally gives rise to a strong quantum Mpemba effect, where a state farther from the steady state relaxes anomalously faster than closer thermal states. Our results establish symmetry-protected fast relaxation as a mechanism for controlling nonequilibrium pathways in open quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Liouvillian mechanism”“eigenmode”“symmetry-filtered mode accessibility”等理论分析框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：开放量子多体系统中的耗散弛豫过程，具体为受退相位噪声影响的长程XXZ自旋链，以及其中由对称性保护的快速弛豫通道和强量子Mpemba效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SU(2)对称点处，高度对称的初始态仅耦合到一个精确的Liouvillian本征模，其衰减速率为λ=-2，产生与系统尺寸和相互作用范围无关的普适指数弛豫；对称性破缺会恢复与慢速Liouvillian模的重叠，显著抑制弛豫动力学，并自然导致强量子Mpemba效应（远离稳态的态反而比更接近热态的态弛豫更快）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SU(2)对称点处，高度对称的初始态仅耦合到一个精确的Liouvillian本征模，其衰减速率为λ=-2，产生与系统尺寸和相互作用范围无关的普适指数弛豫；对称性破缺会恢复与慢速Liouvillian模的重叠，显著抑制弛豫动力学，并自然导致强量子Mpemba效应（远离稳态的态反而比更接近热态的态弛豫更快）。；创新点：揭示了对称性保护的Liouvillian机制——对称性过滤模式可选择性激活快速衰变通道，并以此作为控制开放量子系统非平衡弛豫路径的新机制；同时首次将对称性保护快速弛豫与强量子Mpemba效应建立直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用Liouvillian超算符框架，研究对称性对开放量子多体系统耗散弛豫的约束机制，具体分析长程XXZ自旋链在退相位噪声下的本征模结构。

papers.title: Spin-polarized lasing in a photonic lattice
papers.abstract: We characterize spin-polarized lasing in a two-dimensional photonic lattice fabricated from a GaAs/InGaAs semiconductor microcavity sample. The lattice is defined by a staggered arrangement of rounded rectangular micrometric mesas that laterally confine and couple the optical modes. Polarization-, angle-, and energy-resolved micro-photoluminescence measurements reveal the transition from the strong-coupling regime to photon lasing, accompanied by extended spatial coherence across several lattice unit cells. Under circularly polarized nonresonant excitation, the emitted light acquires a controllable circular polarization whose handedness follows that of the pump. These results establish photonic-lattice VCSELs as a platform for spin-controlled coherent emission in extended optical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“微光致发光测量”（micro-photoluminescence measurements）等实验手段，并涉及样品制备（fabricated from...）。；研究对象：基于GaAs/InGaAs半导体微腔的二维光子晶格，具体为通过交错排列的圆角矩形微米级台面（mesas）定义的光学模式耦合系统，研究其中的自旋极化激光现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维光子晶格中实现了从强耦合激子-光子态到光子激光的转变，并观察到跨越多个晶格原胞的扩展空间相干性；在圆偏振非共振激发下，发射光获得可控的圆偏振，其旋向与泵浦光一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维光子晶格中实现了从强耦合激子-光子态到光子激光的转变，并观察到跨越多个晶格原胞的扩展空间相干性；在圆偏振非共振激发下，发射光获得可控的圆偏振，其旋向与泵浦光一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用偏振分辨、角度分辨和能量分辨的微光致发光（micro-photoluminescence）测量技术，样品为GaAs/InGaAs半导体微腔中制备的二维光子晶格。

papers.title: Chaos-Integrability Transition in the BPS Subspace of the $\mathcal{N}=2$ SYK Model
papers.abstract: We study chaos-integrability transition purely within a BPS subspace of a specific supersymmetric model that interpolates between the chaotic $\mathcal{N}=2$ SYK model and an integrable $\mathcal{N}=2$ "commuting" SYK model. Using the framework of BPS chaos, we analyze the spectrum of an operator projected onto the BPS subspace. We numerically find that its spectral statistics exhibit random-matrix behavior near the SYK limit and smoothly transitions to Poisson statistics near the integrable limit. Our results provide a direct example of a chaos-integrability crossover diagnosed solely from BPS states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectral statistics、random-matrix behavior、Poisson statistics、numerical analysis。；研究对象：$\mathcal{N}=2$ SYK模型及其可积变体（“commuting” SYK模型）的BPS子空间中的混沌-可积转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BPS子空间中，谱统计量从SYK极限附近的随机矩阵行为平滑过渡到可积极限附近的泊松统计，表明仅通过BPS态即可诊断混沌-可积交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BPS子空间中，谱统计量从SYK极限附近的随机矩阵行为平滑过渡到可积极限附近的泊松统计，表明仅通过BPS态即可诊断混沌-可积交叉。；创新点：首次在超对称模型的BPS子空间内部直接展示混沌-可积转变，证明无需考虑全希尔伯特空间，仅从BPS态即可观测到该交叉行为。
papers.method_zh: 利用BPS混沌框架，对投影到BPS子空间上的算符谱进行数值分析，通过谱统计（随机矩阵理论与泊松统计）判断混沌程度。

papers.title: Lasing from SOI-integrated GaAsSb nanowires via resonator-driven optical feedback
papers.abstract: Silicon photonic integrated circuits critically depend on compact on-chip light sources, for which nanowire (NW) lasers are an attractive solution. However, their practical implementation is often limited by broad emission linewidths and poor frequency stability resulting from weak optical feedback. Here, we integrate individual GaAsSb NWs by transfer-printing onto silicon-on-insulator (SOI) racetrack resonators to realize optical feedback at silicon-transparent wavelengths. Finite-difference-time-domain simulations reveal efficient coupling between the hybrid NW-waveguide mode and the fundamental TE resonator mode, with calculated cavity Q-factors exceeding 10$^4$. Experimentally, we observe feedback-induced lasing emission at a low threshold (P$_{th}$) of 8.6 $\pm$ 1.8 $μ$J/cm$^2$. Compared to identical NW lasers without SOI resonator, the linewidth is reduced by more than a factor of four at 3P$_{th}$ and remains stable below 1.8 meV up to 5P$_{th}$. Our results demonstrate NW-based light sources on SOI and show that tailored resonator designs enable improved linewidth control and frequency stabilization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：integrate、experimentally observe、measurements）；研究对象：GaAsSb纳米线集成在SOI（绝缘体上硅）跑道型谐振器上的混合结构，研究其激光发射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将GaAsSb纳米线转移打印到SOI跑道型谐振器上，实现了低阈值（8.6 ± 1.8 μJ/cm²）的激光发射，且线宽在3倍阈值时比无谐振器的纳米线激光器缩小超过4倍，并在5倍阈值以下稳定在1.8 meV以内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将GaAsSb纳米线转移打印到SOI跑道型谐振器上，实现了低阈值（8.6 ± 1.8 μJ/cm²）的激光发射，且线宽在3倍阈值时比无谐振器的纳米线激光器缩小超过4倍，并在5倍阈值以下稳定在1.8 meV以内。；创新点：首次在硅透明波段通过SOI谐振器为纳米线激光器提供光学反馈，实现了线宽压缩和频率稳定性的显著提升，解决了纳米线激光器因弱反馈导致的线宽宽、频率不稳定问题。
papers.method_zh: 实验采用转移打印技术将单根GaAsSb纳米线集成到SOI跑道型谐振器上；理论方面使用有限差分时域（FDTD）模拟计算混合纳米线-波导模式与谐振器基模的耦合效率及腔Q因子（超过10⁴）。

papers.title: Polynomial diagrams for microstructure modelling
papers.abstract: We formulate a framework of polynomial diagrams, which are a generalisation of power diagrams (PDs) and anisotropic power diagrams (APDs) allowing for boundaries between cells to be algebraic curves of a prescribed degree. We show that they arise naturally from rephrasing PDs (APDs) as first-degree (second-degree) instances of linear parametrised minimisation diagrams. We also develop an efficient GPU-accelerated framework for fitting polynomial diagrams to image data using Legendre polynomials and by maximising a regularised concave objective function adapted from classical logistic regression literature. A largely self-contained analysis of the optimisation algorithm is also provided, including identification of scale and gauge invariances and the limiting objective function as the regularisation parameter vanishes. We apply the algorithm to fit polynomial diagrams to electron backscatter diffraction images of steel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：formulate a framework、develop an efficient GPU-accelerated framework、analysis of the optimisation algorithm。；研究对象：微结构建模，具体应用于钢的电子背散射衍射（EBSD）图像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“多项式图”（polynomial diagrams）框架，它是幂图（PDs）和各向异性幂图（APDs）的推广，允许单元之间的边界为指定次数的代数曲线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“多项式图”（polynomial diagrams）框架，它是幂图（PDs）和各向异性幂图（APDs）的推广，允许单元之间的边界为指定次数的代数曲线。；创新点：将幂图推广到高阶代数曲线边界（多项式图），并提供了包含尺度与规范不变性分析以及正则化参数趋零时极限目标函数的自洽优化算法分析。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架上，将幂图和各向异性幂图重新表述为线性参数化最小化图的一阶/二阶实例；数值方法上，利用勒让德多项式并最大化从经典逻辑回归文献中改编的正则化凹目标函数，开发了GPU加速的拟合算法。

papers.title: Multi-Qubit Entanglement of Unit Cell Pairs in SiMOS
papers.abstract: Spin qubits in silicon-MOS (SiMOS) quantum dots have recently demonstrated compatibility with existing industry standard CMOS fabrication techniques. These devices have routinely achieved single- and two-qubit gate fidelities above 99% and demonstrated highly entangled two-qubit Bell states in isolated double quantum dot (DQD) unit cells, however coupling between unit cells has remained challenging. In this work, we present a two unit cell, four-qubit SiMOS processor with universal controllability and fully parallelised state initialisation and readout. We use this processor to generate maximally entangled three-qubit states, including the Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state, and certify multipartite entanglement through violation of the classical Mermin-witness bound. By using a fully symmetric dynamically decoupled gate sequence to create our entangled states, we are able to preserve the lifetime of the entanglement beyond $T_2^*$, to a time limited instead by $T_2^\textrm{Hahn}$. These demonstrations pave a road to the scalable operation of larger SiMOS processors, and achieving high purity, long-lived multi-qubit entangled states in them.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“present a two unit cell, four-qubit SiMOS processor”并进行了量子态制备与测量。；研究对象：硅-金属氧化物半导体（SiMOS）量子点中的多量子比特纠缠态，具体为两个单元胞、四个自旋量子比特的处理器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功在SiMOS四量子比特处理器中生成了最大纠缠的三量子比特态（包括GHZ态），并通过违反经典Mermin-witness界认证了多体纠缠；同时利用全对称动态解耦门序列将纠缠寿命延长至超过$T_2^*$，受限于$T_2^\text{Hahn}$。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功在SiMOS四量子比特处理器中生成了最大纠缠的三量子比特态（包括GHZ态），并通过违反经典Mermin-witness界认证了多体纠缠；同时利用全对称动态解耦门序列将纠缠寿命延长至超过$T_2^*$，受限于$T_2^\text{Hahn}$。；创新点：首次在SiMOS体系中实现两个单元胞之间的耦合，并演示了可扩展的四量子比特处理器，生成了三量子比特最大纠缠态（GHZ态），且通过动态解耦显著延长了纠缠寿命。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用与工业标准CMOS工艺兼容的SiMOS量子点器件，构建了两个单元胞（四个量子比特）的处理器，实现了通用可控性、全并行初始化与读出。使用全对称动态解耦门序列生成纠缠态，并通过Mermin-witness不等式违反来认证多体纠缠。

papers.title: Entangling Power: A Probe of Symmetry and Integrability in Quantum Many-Body Systems
papers.abstract: The entangling power of a unitary operator quantifies its ability to generate entanglement from product states and provides a natural probe of quantum many-body dynamics. Entanglement extremization at points of enhanced symmetry has previously been observed in high-energy scattering. In this work we compute the time-averaged entangling power of anisotropic Heisenberg spin chains across two-site models and finite-size systems, as well as the entangling power of the two-magnon $S$-matrix in the thermodynamic limit. For two-site models we establish a monotonic hierarchy: the entangling power decreases as the symmetry group grows, reaching its minimum at the $SU(2)$ XXX point. Finite-size XXZ chains exhibit sharp dips at the $SU(2)$ points $Δ=\pm 1$ and the free-fermion point $Δ=0$, with the free-fermion dip decaying much more slowly with system size. In the thermodynamic limit, we decompose the two-magnon $S$-matrix into quantum logic gates -- Identity, SWAP, and $σ_z\otimesσ_z$ -- and show that the entangling power vanishes for all scattering energies at the $SU(2)$ points, where the $S$-matrix reduces to the Identity gate, while the free-fermion point achieves the maximum -- the opposite of the finite-size many-body behavior. The entangling power can serve as an {\em operator} diagnostic for symmetry and selected aspects of integrability in quantum simulations of spin-chain dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“计算了时间平均纠缠能力”、“分解为量子逻辑门”等理论分析手段，未涉及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的纠缠能力，具体针对各向异性海森堡自旋链（包括两比特模型、有限尺寸系统以及热力学极限下的双磁子S矩阵）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠能力随对称性增大而单调递减，在SU(2) XXX点达到最小；在热力学极限下，SU(2)点的S矩阵退化为单位门，纠缠能力为零，而自由费米子点（Δ=0）纠缠能力最大，与有限尺寸行为相反。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠能力随对称性增大而单调递减，在SU(2) XXX点达到最小；在热力学极限下，SU(2)点的S矩阵退化为单位门，纠缠能力为零，而自由费米子点（Δ=0）纠缠能力最大，与有限尺寸行为相反。；创新点：提出纠缠能力可作为量子多体系统中对称性和可积性的“算符诊断工具”，并揭示了有限尺寸与热力学极限下纠缠能力行为的反转。
papers.method_zh: 计算时间平均纠缠能力；对两比特模型和有限尺寸XXZ链进行解析或数值分析；在热力学极限下将双磁子S矩阵分解为Identity、SWAP和σ_z⊗σ_z量子逻辑门。

papers.title: Entanglement Growth from Structured Initial States in Many-Body Localized Systems
papers.abstract: Understanding how complex entanglement structures emerge is a central problem in quantum many-body physics. Recent work by Zhang et al. has considered structured initial states prepared by evolving a product state under a chaotic Hamiltonian for a finite time before quenching to the target Hamiltonian. In this setup, total entanglement entropy growth in many-body localized systems exhibits two distinct regimes, first increasing and then decreasing as the initial entanglement is tuned. In this work, we identify the physical origin of this behavior by analyzing the dynamics of both the Rényi entanglement entropy and the Wehrl-Rényi entropy in the random-field XXZ model, the latter of which characterizes multipartite entanglement. We show that a similar non-monotonic dependence on the initial entanglement also appears in the net growth of the Wehrl-Rényi entropy for product states polarized along the $z$-direction. The first regime is governed by a finite magnetization associated with local integrals of motion, while the second reflects inter-site correlations. In contrast, for product states in the $x/y$-direction, the entanglement growth exhibits a monotonic decay. Our results provide a more fine-grained picture of how distinct initial-state properties shape entanglement dynamics in many-body localized systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：分析动力学、数值计算（随机场XXZ模型）、熵分析。；研究对象：多体局域化系统中的纠缠增长动力学，特别是从结构化初始态（由混沌哈密顿量预演化制备的初态）出发的纠缠熵与多体纠缠演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多体局域化系统中，总纠缠熵随初始纠缠量的变化呈现非单调行为（先增后减），该行为源于两个不同物理机制的竞争：第一个阶段由局域守恒量相关的有限磁化主导，第二个阶段反映格点间关联；而对于沿x/y方向极化的初态，纠缠增长则单调衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多体局域化系统中，总纠缠熵随初始纠缠量的变化呈现非单调行为（先增后减），该行为源于两个不同物理机制的竞争：第一个阶段由局域守恒量相关的有限磁化主导，第二个阶段反映格点间关联；而对于沿x/y方向极化的初态，纠缠增长则单调衰减。；创新点：揭示了多体局域化系统中结构化初态纠缠增长非单调行为的物理起源，区分了局域磁化与格点间关联两种不同机制，并发现初态极化方向对纠缠动力学的定性影响（非单调 vs 单调衰减）。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析随机场XXZ模型中的Rényi纠缠熵和Wehrl-Rényi熵（后者表征多体纠缠）的动力学，研究不同极化方向（z方向与x/y方向）的初态下纠缠增长对初始纠缠量的依赖关系。

papers.title: WSi weak link element with a non-sinusoidal current-phase relation
papers.abstract: Nonlinearity is an essential ingredient for encoding quantum states with non-uniform energy spacing, implementing coherent quantum gates, reading out qubits, amplifying, and mixing electromagnetic signals. In this work, we demonstrate the nonlinear behavior of a constriction fabricated from an amorphous, high-kinetic inductance material, tungsten silicide, embedded in a three-dimensional RF-SQUID. We find that the results are consistent with the weak link behaving as a Josephson junction with a sawtooth-like current-phase relation or a quantum phase slip element. Finally, we measure relaxation times of the metastable, persistent-current states trapped in the local minima of the potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate the nonlinear behavior”、“measure relaxation times”等实验操作和测量行为。；研究对象：非晶态高动能电感材料钨硅化物（tungsten silicide）制成的微桥（constriction）弱连接元件，嵌入三维RF-SQUID（射频超导量子干涉器）中，研究其电流-相位关系及非线性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该弱连接元件的非线性行为与具有锯齿状电流-相位关系的约瑟夫森结或量子相位滑移元件的行为一致；测量了势能局部极小值中亚稳态持续电流态的弛豫时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该弱连接元件的非线性行为与具有锯齿状电流-相位关系的约瑟夫森结或量子相位滑移元件的行为一致；测量了势能局部极小值中亚稳态持续电流态的弛豫时间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备非晶态钨硅化物微桥，将其嵌入三维RF-SQUID结构中，通过测量其非线性响应和弛豫时间来分析电流-相位关系。

papers.title: Probing Lattice Dynamics in Real-Space and Real-Time
papers.abstract: The coherent lattice vibrations significantly impact physical and chemical processes in solids, such as heat transfer, displacive phase transitions, and thermal conductivity. Thus, probing lattice dynamics in real-space and real-time is essential for understanding ubiquitous phenomena in solids. High-harmonic spectroscopy (HHS) has emerged as a preferred technique for investigating static and dynamic properties of solids on ultrafast timescales. Yet, despite these accomplishments, the applicability of HHS to probe the influence of coherent lattice vibrations on electronic responses has remained unexplored. In this thesis, we explore the impact of coherent lattice dynamics on attosecond electronic responses in solids using HHS. We observe that coherent excitation of the in-plane phonon mode in graphene results in sidebands in the harmonic spectrum, separated by the frequency of the excited phonon mode. Additionally, we demonstrate the capability of HHS to characterize energy, polarization, phase difference, and the "chirality" of phonon modes. This thesis offers an avenue to probe phonon-driven processes in solids with sub-cycle temporal resolution. In the later segment, our focus shifts toward probing coherent lattice dynamics in real-space and real-time. We demonstrate that inelastic scattering techniques, combined with theoretical analysis, yield comparable results to those from time-resolved diffraction and imaging measurements within pump-probe configurations. Our findings exhibit excellent agreement with results from a time-resolved diffuse x-ray scattering experiment. Our proposed method serves as an alternative to time-resolved diffraction and imaging methods for probing lattice dynamics in real-space and real-time with atomic-scale spatiotemporal resolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析+实验验证）。关键词：high-harmonic spectroscopy (HHS)、inelastic scattering techniques、time-resolved diffuse x-ray scattering experiment。；研究对象：固体中的相干晶格动力学（coherent lattice dynamics），具体以石墨烯（graphene）的面内声子模为研究对象，探讨其对电子响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用高次谐波光谱（HHS）观察到石墨烯中相干激发面内声子模会在谐波谱中产生边带，边带间隔等于激发声子模的频率；同时，HHS能够表征声子模的能量、偏振、相位差及“手性”。此外，非弹性散射技术结合理论分析可在实空间和实时间上探测晶格动力学，结果与时间分辨衍射/成像测量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用高次谐波光谱（HHS）观察到石墨烯中相干激发面内声子模会在谐波谱中产生边带，边带间隔等于激发声子模的频率；同时，HHS能够表征声子模的能量、偏振、相位差及“手性”。此外，非弹性散射技术结合理论分析可在实空间和实时间上探测晶格动力学，结果与时间分辨衍射/成像测量一致。；创新点：首次将高次谐波光谱（HHS）应用于探测相干晶格振动对电子响应的影响，并展示了其表征声子模式多种属性（能量、偏振、相位差、手性）的能力；同时提出非弹性散射技术作为时间分辨衍射/成像方法的替代方案，用于实现原子级时空分辨率的晶格动力学探测。
papers.method_zh: 高次谐波光谱（HHS）用于探测超快时间尺度上的电子响应；非弹性散射技术（inelastic scattering techniques）结合理论分析，并与时间分辨漫散射X射线实验（time-resolved diffuse x-ray scattering experiment）结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: TriForces: Augmenting Atomistic GNNs for Transferable Representations
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) achieve excellent accuracy when trained on large Density Functional Theory (DFT) data. To be useful in practice, they must often be adapted to target chemistries using small and expensive task-specific datasets. However, MLIPs transfer inconsistently across domains, with representations that often loose accessible composition and structure information. To address this, we present TriForces, a model-agnostic three-stream framework that separates composition and structure information, combined with self-supervised learning to preserve transferable representations. TriForces improves performance on MatBench and QM9 over baselines without needing DFT labels and enables efficient similar structure retrieval through its learned latent space. On OMat24, in limited-data training regime, TriForces reduces energy MAE by 57% at 20K samples only and improves force MAE across sample sizes. We release pretrained TriForces variants across multiple MLIP architectures with code at https://github.com/Ramlaoui/triforces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、self-supervised learning、latent space。；研究对象：原子间势能机器学习模型（MLIPs）的迁移学习与表示学习，具体涉及MatBench、QM9、OMat24等数据集中的材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出TriForces框架，通过分离组成与结构信息并结合自监督学习，显著提升了MLIPs在不同化学体系间的迁移性能，在有限数据训练下将能量MAE降低57%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出TriForces框架，通过分离组成与结构信息并结合自监督学习，显著提升了MLIPs在不同化学体系间的迁移性能，在有限数据训练下将能量MAE降低57%。；创新点：提出了一种模型无关的三流架构，通过显式分离组成与结构信息，结合自监督学习，解决了MLIPs跨领域迁移时表示丢失可访问组成与结构信息的问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用模型无关的三流（three-stream）框架，将组成信息与结构信息分离处理，并引入自监督学习（self-supervised learning）以保持可迁移的表示。在OMat24数据集上进行了有限数据训练实验。

papers.title: Ultrafast excitation of Bloch plasmon polaritons in hyperbolic metamaterials with an extreme ultra-violet transient grating
papers.abstract: Manipulating materials properties with light drives advances in materials science and photonics. Hyperbolic metamaterials are promising candidates as next-generation quantum optical media. They support Bloch plasmon polaritons, which are characterized by potentially infinite wave-vectors and long lifetimes, but cannot be excited through direct light illumination due to momentum mismatch. Here, we experimentally show that a transient grating, formed via interference of fully coherent seeded free-electron laser pulses in a thin insulator film, enables the excitation of Bloch plasmon polaritons in an underlying hyperbolic metamaterial. Finite element simulations confirm the role of the transient grating in facilitating phase-matching and mode excitation. Our findings demonstrate a route to spatiotemporally excite Bloch plasmon polaritons modes, offering an alternative to permanently nanostructured gratings and potentially enabling ultrafast control of optical modes excitation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimentally show”、“finite element simulations”表明包含实验验证和模拟支持。；研究对象：双曲超材料中的布洛赫等离激元极化激元（Bloch plasmon polaritons），以及通过瞬态光栅激发该模式的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用全相干种子自由电子激光脉冲在薄膜中干涉形成的瞬态光栅，成功实现了对双曲超材料中布洛赫等离激元极化激元的激发，解决了动量失配问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用全相干种子自由电子激光脉冲在薄膜中干涉形成的瞬态光栅，成功实现了对双曲超材料中布洛赫等离激元极化激元的激发，解决了动量失配问题。；创新点：提出并演示了利用瞬态光栅（而非永久性纳米结构光栅）实现布洛赫等离激元极化激元的时空激发，为光学模式的超快控制提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用全相干种子自由电子激光脉冲在薄绝缘膜中形成瞬态光栅，激发下方双曲超材料中的布洛赫等离激元极化激元；理论上通过有限元模拟验证瞬态光栅在相位匹配和模式激发中的作用。

papers.title: Ultrafast temperature diagnosis of dynamically compressed matter using millielectronvolt inelastic x-ray scattering beyond the first Brillouin zone
papers.abstract: We present calculations of the millielectronvolt-scale x-ray scattering spectra of multilayered dynamic-compression targets comprising an unstructured ablator layer and a crystalline, textured sample layer. Our model builds on the classic formulation of x-ray thermal diffuse scattering by Warren [B. E. Warren, Acta Crystallogr. 6, 803 (1953)] and includes both elastic and first-order (single-phonon) inelastic scattering contributions to the dynamic structure factor $S(\mathbf{q},ω)$. We focus on the umklapp scattering regime (i.e., at momentum transfers outside the first Brillouin zone) where the ablator scattering that threatens to overwhelm the inelastic scattering from the crystalline layer of interest is suppressed. We show that, despite the considerably more complex structure of the inelastic scattering spectra in this intermediate-$q$ regime, it is still possible to reliably deduce the temperature of the crystal using Dornheim's Laplace-transform--based formalism [Dornheim et al., Phys. Plasmas 30, 042707 (2023)], regardless of the details of the sample's texture.
